a: Asur lilvot dinar bedinar.

Dinar demay? illema dinar shel kesef bedinar shel kesef, legabbe nafsheh mi ikka leman deamar lav tiva have? ella peshita dinar shel zahav bedinar shel zahav, uleman? i levet hillel – ha amri tiva have. ella lav levet shammay, ushema minna rabbi yochanan hu deamar: en mechallelin!

La, leolam ema lach rabbi yochanan hu deamar mechallelin, veshane halevaa kevan dilinyan mikkach umimkar shavveyuhv rabbanan ki fera, deamrinan: ihu nihu deoker vezil – legabbe halevaa name pera have.
Hachi name mistabbera, dechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: af al pi sheamru asur lilvot dinar bedinar, aval mechallelin maaser sheni alav. shema minna.

Ta shema: happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni, bet shammay omrim: bechol hassela maot, uvet hillel omrim: beshekel kesef, beshekel maot. hasheta levet shammay legabbe perite mechallelinan, legabbe dahava mibbaya? shane perite beatra desagayin charife.
Lishshana acharina amri la, rabbi yochanan veresh lakish. chad amar: machloket bislain al dinarim, devet shammay savri: "hakkesef" – kesef rishon velo kesef sheni.
Uvet hillel savri: "hakkesef", "kesef", ribba – vaafillu kesef sheni. aval perot al dinarin – divre hakkol mechallelinan, deakkatti kesef rishon hu.
Vechad amar: af beferot al dinarin name machloket.
Uleman deamar selain al dinarin machloket, addemippalgi bislain al dinarin, liflog bislain al selain!
I ippelug bislain al selain, hava amena: hane mille bislain al selain, aval bislain al dinarin – modu lehu bet hillel levet shammay dedahava legabbe kaspa pera have vela mechallelinan, ka mashma lan.

Ta shema: happoret sela shel maaser sheni birushalayim, bet shammay omrim: bechol hassela maot, uvet hillel omrim: beshekel kesef, beshekel maot. hasheta kaspa legabbe perite mechallelinan, vela amrinan "kesef rishon velo kesef sheni", legabbe dahava dachashiv minneh, mi amrinan "kesef rishon velo kesef sheni"?
Amar rava: yerushalayim kamotvat? shane yerushalayim, dichtiv beh "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha babbakar uvatztzon".
Ta shema: happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni – bet shammay omrim: bechol hassela maot, uvet hillel omrim: beshekel kesef, beshekel maot!

Ella dechulle alma "hakkesef" "kesef" ribba, vaafillu kesef sheni. ella i ittemar derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish, hachi ittemar: chad amar machloket bislain al dinarin, devet shammay savri: gazrinan
b: Shemma yeshahe aliyyotav, dezimnin dela malu zuze bedinara vela massek. uvet hillel savri: la gazrinan shemma yeshahe aliyyotav, dechi la malu name bedinara assoke massek lehu. aval beferot al dinarin – divre hakkol mechallelinan, dechevan demarkevi la meshahe lehu.
Vechad amar: afillu beferot al dinarin name machloket.

Bishlama lehach lishshana deamrat demiddeorayyta mishra shere verabbanan hu digzaru beh – hayeynu dekatane "yaase" velo yaase", ella lehach lishshana deamrat demiddeorayyta peligi: mechallelinan vela mechallelinan mibbee leh? kashya.

Ittemar: rav velevi, chad amar: matbea naase chalifin, vechad amar: en matbea naase chalifin. amar rav pappa: may tama deman deamar en matbea naase chalifin – mishshum dedateh atztzureta, vetzureta avida devatla.
Tenan: hazzahav kone et hakkesef, may lav bachalifin, ushema minna matbea naase chalifin? lo, bedamim. i hachi hazzahav kone et hakkesef, mechayyev mibbee leh! teni: hazzahav mechayyev.

Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: hakkesef eno kone et hazzahav. i amrat bishlama bedamim – hayeynu deamrinan dahava pera, vechaspa tiva, vetiva pera la kane. ella i amrat bachalifin, tarvayyhu likno ahadade.

Veod, tanya: hakkesef eno kone et hazzahav, ketzad? machar lo esrim vachamishsha dinar shel kesef bedinar shel zahav, af al pi shemmashach et hakkesef – lo kana ad sheyyimshoch et hazzahav. i amrat bishlama bedamim – mishshum hachi la kane. ella i amrat bachalifin – nikne.

Ella may, bedamim? i hachi ema resha: hazzahav kone et hakkesef, ketzad? machar lo dinar shel zahav beesrim vachamishsha dinar shel kesef, kevan shemmashach et hazzahav nikna kesef bechol makom shehu.
I amrat bishlama bachalifin, hayeynu dekatane "nikne kesef bechol makom shehu". ella i amrat bedamim, hay "nikne kesef bechol makom shehu", nitchayyev gavra mibbee leh.

Amar rav ashe: leolam bedamim. umay "bechol makom shehu"? kemot shehu, kedaamar leh. i amar leh: mearnaki chadasha yahavina lach, la matze yahev leh mearnaki yeshana, af al gav daadifi minnayyhu. may tama, deamar leh: leyashshenan ka vaena lehu.

Amar rav pappa: afillu leman deamar en matbea naase chalifin – mebad hu dela aved chalifin, aknoye mikkenu bachalifin, midde dehave appere lerav nachman. pere lerav nachman, lav af al gav deinhu la avdi chalifin – aknoye mikkenu bachalifin, tiva name la shena.
Metivi: haya omed baggoren veen beyado maot, omer lachavero: hare perot hallalu netunim lecha bemattana,

a: Vechozer veomer: hare hen mechullalin al meot sheyyesh li babbayit. tama deen beyado maot, ha im yesh beyado maot – laykne lehu leiddach bimshicha ufarek, dehachi adif, dehave leh nuchray.
Vei amrat matbea nikne bachalifin: nikkeno leh maot lehayech aggav sudar, velifrok! delet leh sudar. venakninhu nihaleh aggav karka! delet leh karka.
Veha omed baggoren katane! begoren sheeno shello. veikkefal tanna leashmoinan gavra artilay delet leh vela kelum? ella lav, shema minna: en matbea nikne bachalifin. shema minna.
Veaf rav pappa hadar beh. ki ha derav pappa havo leh teresar alfe dinare be chozae, akninhu lerav shemuel bar acha aggav assippa deveteh. ki ata, nefak leappeh ad tevoch.
Vechen amar ulla: en matbea naase chalifin. vechen amar rav assi: en matbea naase chalifin, vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: en matbea naase chalifin.

Etiveh rabbi abba leulla: hare shehayu chamarav ufoalav tovin oto bashshuk, veamar lashshulechani: ten li bedinar maot vaafarnesem, vaani aale lecha yafe dinar uteresit mimmaot sheyyesh li beveti. im yesh lo maot – muttar, veim lav – asur. vei salka datach en matbea naase chalifin, havya leh halevaa, veasur! ishtik.

Amar leh: dilma idde veidde bifrutatot shanu, delekka alayyhu tiva. veidde veidde pera havu, umishshum hachi nikkeno bachalifin. amar leh: in, dayka name, dekatane: yafe dinar uteresit, vela katane: dinar yafe uteresit. shema minna.
Rav ashe amar: leolam bedamim uvifrutatot, kevan deit leh, naase keomer: haleveni ad sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza mafteach.
Ta shema: kol hannaase damim beacher, kevan shezzacha ze – nitchayyev ze bachalifin. kol hannaase damim beacher, may nihu – matbea, ushema minna matbea naase chalifin!
Amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar:
b: Kol hannishshom damim beacher, kevan shezzacha ze nitchayyev ze bachalifin.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: ketzad? hechlif shor befara o chamor beshor. shema minna.
Ulemay dislek addateh meikkara – matbea, may "ketzad"? hachi kaamar, ufere name avdi chalifin, ketzad – hechlif shor befara o chamor beshor.
Hanicha lerav sheshet, deamar pere avdi chalifin, ella lerav nachman, deamar: keli – in, aval pere la avdi chalifin, may "ketzad"?
Hachi kaamar: yesh damim shehen kachalifin, ketzad? hechlif deme shor befara o deme chamor beshor.
May tameh derav nachman? savar la kerabbi yochanan. deamar: devar tora maot konot. umippene ma amru meshicha kona – gezera shemma yomar lo: nisrefu chittecha baaliyyay.
Umilleta dishchicha – gezaru beh rabbanan. milleta dela shechicha – la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Uleresh lakish deamar meshicha meforeshet min hattora, hanicha i savar la kerav sheshet, metaretz la kerav sheshet.
Ella i savar la kerav nachman, deamar: pere la avdi chalifin umatbea la kane, hechi metaretz la? al kurchach kerav sheshet metaretz la.

Tenan: kol hammittaltelin konin ze et ze. veamar resh lakish: vaafillu kis male maot bechis male maot! targema rav acha: bedinar an[ya]ka vaanigra, echad sheppesalattu malchut, veechad sheppesalattu medina.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan pesalattu malchut – mishshum dela sage kelal. aval pesalattu medina, desage leh bimdina achariti – ema akkatti matbea hu veen matbea nikne bachalifin.
Vei ashmeinan pesalattu medina – mishshum dela sage leh la betzina vela befarhesya. aval pesalattu malchut, desage leh betzina – ema akkatti matbea hu, veen matbea nikne bachalifin. tzericha.
Amar rabba amar rav huna: "mechor li beellu", kana,

a: Veyesh lo alav onaa.

Kana – af al gav dela mashach, dechevan dela kafed – kana, dechi chalifin dame. veyesh lo alav onaa – dimchor li beellu" kaamar leh. rav abba amar rav huna: "mechor li beellu" – kana, veen lo alav onaa.
Peshita: damim veen makpid alehen – ha kaamrinan dekane, dechachalifin damu. chalifin umakpid alehen, may?

Amar rav adda bar ahava, ta shema: hare shehaya tofes parato veomed, uva chavero veamar lo: paratcha lamma? lachamor ani tzarich. yesh li chamor sheani noten lecha. paratcha bechamma? bechach vechach. chamorcha bechamma? bechach vechach.
Mashach baal hachamor et happara, velo hispik baal happara limshoch et hachamor ad shemmet hachamor – lo kana baal hachamor et happara.
Shema minna: chalifin umakpid alehen – lo kana.

Amar rava: attu chalifin beshufetane askinan, dela kafdi? ella kol chalifin mikpad kafdi vekana. vehacha bemay askinan – daamar leh: chamor befara vetale, umashach et happara vaadayin lo mashach et hattale, dela have leh meshicha maalya.
Amar mar: "mechor li beellu" – kana, veyesh lo alav onaa. lema savar rav huna matbea naase chalifin?

La, rav huna savar la kerabbi yochanan deamar: devar tora maot konot. umippene ma amru meshicha kona – gezera shemma yomar lo nisrefu chittecha baaliyyay. milleta dishchicha – gezaru ba rabbanan, umilleta dela shechicha – la gezaru ba rabbanan. amar leh mar huna bereh derav nachman lerav ashe: attun, hachi matnitu la, anan hachi matnenan la: vechen amar rav huna, en matbea naase chalifin.
Bamme konin?
Rav amar: bechilyo shel kone. denicha leh lekone deleheve makne kone, ki hechi deligmar velakne leh. velevi amar: bechilyo shel makne, kidvaenan lememar lekamman.

Amar leh rav huna middiskarta lerava: ulelevi, deamar bechilyo shel makne, ha ka kane ara aggav gelima. im ken, havu leh nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut veniknin im nechasim sheen lahen achrayut. vaanan ippecha tenan: nechasim sheen lahen achrayut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut!
Amar leh: i hava levi hacha, hava mappek leappach pulese denura! mi savrat gelima makne leh? behahi hanaa deka mekabbel minneh – gamar umakne leh.

Ketannae: "vezot lefanim beyisrael al haggeulla veal hattemura lekayyem kol davar shalaf ish naalo venatan lereehu". "geulla" – zo mechira, vechen hu omer: "lo yiggael". "temura" – zo chalifin, vechen hu omer: "lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto".
"Lekayyem kol davar shalaf ish naalo venatan lereehu". mi natan lemi? boaz natan laggoel. rabbi yehuda omer: goel natan levoaz.

Tana: konin bichli af al pi sheen bo shave peruta. amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella bichli, aval befere – la. rav sheshet amar: afillu beferot. may tama derav nachman? amar kera "naalo", naal – in, midde acharina – la.

May tameh derav sheshet, amar kera: "lekayyem kol davar". lerav nachman name, hachtiv: "lekayyem kol davar"! hahu lekayyem kol davar, deniknin beminal. verav sheshet name, hachtiv: "naalo"! amar lecha rav sheshet: ma naalo davar hamesuyyaym – af kol davar hamesuyyaym, leappoke chatzi rimmon vachatzi egoz, dela.

Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: keman katvinan haiddana "bemana dechashar lemikneya beh". "bemana" – leappoke midderav sheshet, deamar konin beferot. "dechashar" – leappoke middishmuel, deamar konin
b: Bemaroka. "lemikneya" – leappoke middelevi, deamar bechilyo shel makne, ka mashma lan "lemikneya" vela "l[a]kenoye". "beh" – rav pappa amar: lemaote matbea. verav zevid, veittema rav ashe amar: lemaote issure hanaa.
Ikka deamri: "beh" – amar rav pappa: lemaote matbea. "dechashar" – amar rav zevid, veittema rav ashe: lemaote issure hanaa. aval morika la itzterich.
Asimon kone et hammatbea vechulei. may "asimon"? amar rav: maot hannittanot besiman levet hammerchatz.

Metivi: en mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon velo al maot hannittanot besiman levet hammerchatz. mikkelal daasimon lav maot hannittanot besiman levet hammerchatz! vechi tema paroshe kamfaresh – veha la tanna hachi: mechallelin maaser sheni al asimon, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim: en mechallelin. veshavin sheen mechallelin al maot hannittanot besiman levet hammerchatz!

Ella amar rabbi yochanan: may asimon – pulesa. veazda rabbi yochanan letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan: rabbi dosa verabbi yishmael amru davar echad, rabbi dosa – ha daamaran. rabbi yishmael may hi, detanya: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha" – lerabbot kol davar hannitzrar bayyad, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: lerabbot kol davar sheyyesh alav tzura.

Ketzad: mashach hemennu perot velo natan lo maot – eno yachol lachazor bo vechulei. amar rabbi yochanan: devar tora maot konot, umippene ma amru meshicha kona – gezera shemma yomar lo "nisrefu chittecha baaliyyay".
Sof sof, man dishda deleka bae shallome! ella: gezera shemma tippol deleka beones. i mokmat lehu birshuteh – masar nafsheh, tarach umatztzel. vei la – la masar nafsheh, tarach umatztzel.
Resh lakish amar: meshicha meforeshet min hattora. may tama deresh lakish? amar kera: "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha", davar hannikne miyyad leyad.
Verabbi yochanan amar: "miyyad" – lemaote karka, delet ba onaa.
Veresh lakish, im ken lichtov kera: "vechi timkeru mimkar miyyad amitecha al tonu", "o kano" lema li? shema minna limshicha.
Verabbi yochanan: "o kano" may aved leh? mibbee leh, lechidtanya: "vechi timkeru mimkar al tonu", en li ella shennitanna lokeach, nitanna mocher minnayin? talmud lomar: "o kano al tonu".
Veresh lakish: tarte gamar minneh.

Tenan, rabbi shimon omer: kol shehakkesef beyado – yado al haelyona. mocher hu dematze hadar beh, lokeach la matze hadar beh. i amrat bishlama maot konot – mishshum hachi mocher matze hadar beh, lokeach la matze hadar beh. ella i amrat maot enan konot – lokeach name lihdar beh!
Amar lach resh lakish: allibba derabbi shimon – la kaamena, ki kaamena – allibba derabbanan.

Bishlama leresh lakish – hayeynu deikka ben rabbi shimon lerabbanan. ella lerabbi yochanan, may ikka ben rabbi shimon lerabbanan? ikka benayyhu derav chisda. deamar rav chisda: kederech shettikkenu meshicha bammochrin kach tiknu meshicha ballakochot. rabbi shimon let leh derav chisda, rabbanan it lehu derav chisda.

Tenan: aval amru, mi sheppara middor hammabbul – hu atid lippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo. i amrat bishlama maot konot – mishshum hachi kae baaval", ella i amrat maot enan konot, ammay kae baaval"? mishshum devarim.
Uvidvarim mi kae baaval"? vehatanya,

a: Rabbi shimon omer: af al pi sheamru tallit kona dinar zahav veen dinar zahav kone tallit, mikkol makom kach halacha. aval amru: mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umeanshe dor happelagga umeanshe sedom vaamora umimmitzrayim bayyam – hu atid lippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo.
Vehannose venoten bidvarim – lo kana, vehachozer bo – en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu.
Veamar rava: anu en lanu ella "en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu". devarim veikka bahadayyhu maot – kae baaval". devarim velekka bahadayyhu maot – la kae baaval".

Amar rava, kera umatnita mesayyay leh leresh lakish. kera, dichtiv: "vechichesh baamito befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel o ashak et amito". "tesumet yad" – amar rav chisda: kegon sheyyiched lo keli lehalevaato. "ashak" – amar rav chisda: kegon sheyyiched lo keli leoshko.

Vechi ahdereh kera, ketiv: "vehaya ki yecheta veashem veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal o et haoshek asher ashak o et happikkadon asher hofkad itto", veillu tesumet yad la ahdereh, may tama? lav mishshum dimchassera meshicha?
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: ema meoshek hu, deahdar kera! hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennetalo mimmennu vechazar vehifkido etzlo.
Hayeynu pikkadon! tere gavne pikkadon.
I hachi, tesumet yad name layhdereh, velokmeh kegon shennetalo hemennu vechazar vehifkido etzlo! i ahdereh kera – la teyuveta vela siyyayta. hasheta dela ahdereh kera – mesayyay leh.

Utesumet yad la ahdereh kera? vehatanya, amar rabbi shimon: minnayin litten et haamur lemala lematta, dichtiv: "o mikkol asher yishshava alav lashsheker", veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: lerabbot tesumet yad lehishshavon. behedya miha la ahdereh kera.
Matnita menalan? detanya: netanah levallan maal, veamar rav: davka ballan hu dela mechassera meshicha, aval midde achariti dimchassera meshicha – lo maal ad demashech.
Vehatanya: netanah lesappar maal. vesappar ha bae lemimshach tisporet. hacha bemay askinan – besappar goy, delav bar meshicha hu.
Tanya name hachi: netanah lesappar o lesappan o lechol baale ummanut – lo maal ad demashech. kashyayn ahadade. ella lav, shema minna: kan besappar goy, kan besappar yisrael. shema minna.
Vechen amar rav nachman, devar tora maot konot. uvadka levi bematniteh veashkach: netanah lesiton – maal!
b: Ella kashya leresh lakish! amar lach resh lakish: ha manni rabbi shimon hi.
Aval amru mi sheppara vechulei. ittemar, abbaye amar: odoe modinan leh. rava amar: melat layytinan leh.
Abbaye amar: odoe modinan leh, dichtiv: "venasi veammecha lo taor". rava amar: melat layytinan leh, dichtiv: "beammecha" – beose maase ammecha.

Amar rava, mena amena la? derabbi chiyyay bar yosef yehavu leh zuze ammilcha. lesof iyyaykkar milcha. ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: zil hav lehu, vei la – kabbel alaych "mi sheppara". vei amrat odoe modinan leh, rabbi chiyyay bar yosef bar odoe hu. veella may – melat layytinan leh? rabbi chiyyay bar yosef ate lekabbole aleh latuta derabbanan?!
Ella rabbi chiyyay bar yosef eravon hu deyahavi leh. hu savar: kenegdo hu kone. vaamar leh rabbi yochanan: keneged kullo hu kone.
Ittemar: eravon, rav omer: kenegdo hu kone, verabbi yochanan amar: keneged kullo hu kone.

Metivi: hannoten eravon lachavero, veamar lo: "im ani chozer bi – ervoni machul lach", vehalla omer lo: "im ani echzor bi, echpol lecha ervoncha" – nitkayyeymu hattenaim, divre rabbi yose. rabbi yose letameh, deamar: asmachta kanya.

Rabbi yehuda omer: dayyo sheyyikne keneged ervono. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – bizman sheamar lo "ervoni yikkon". aval machar lo bayit o sade beelef zuz, ufara lo mehem chamesh meot zuz – kana, umachazir lo et hashshear afillu leachar kamma shanim. may lav hu haddin lemittaltelin, (bedistama) [devistama] kane lehu lechullehu!
La, mittaltelin bistama la kane. umay shena karka, divchaspa kane leh mammash – kane leh lechulla. mittaltele dela kane ella lekabbole "mi sheppara" – la kane leh kulleh.

Lema ketannae: hammalve et chavero al hammashkon, venichnesa hashshemitta, af al pi sheeno shave ella pelag – eno meshammet, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel. rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: im haya mashkon keneged halevaato – eno meshammet, veim lav – meshammet.
May "eno meshammet" dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel? illema kenegdo, mikkelal derabbi yehuda hannasi savar: lehach palga name meshammet!

a: Ella mashkon denaket lema leh? ella lav, shema minneh: may "eno meshammet" dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel – eno meshammet bechullo, umay "meshammet" dekaamar rabbi yehuda hannasi – lehach palga dela naket aleh mashkon.
Uveha kamippalgi, derabban shimon ben gamliel savar: keneged kullo hu kone, verabbi yehuda hannasi savar: kenegdo hu kone.

La, may "eno meshammet" dekaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel – lehach palga denaket aleh mashkon, mikkelal derabbi yehuda hannasi savar: lehach palga denaket aleh mashkon name meshammet. ella mashkon denaket, lema leh? lezichron devarim bealma.
Rav kahana yehavu leh zuze akkittana, lesof iyyaykkar kittana. ata lekammeh derav. amar leh: bemay dinkitat zuze – hav lehu, veiddach – devarim ninhu, udevarim en bahen mishshum mechussere amana.
Deittemar: devarim, rav amar: en bahen mishshum mechussere amana, verabbi yochanan amar: yesh bahem mishshum mechussere amana.

Metivi, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ma talmud lomar "hin tzedek", vahalo "hin" bichlal efa haya? ella lomar lach: sheyyehe hen shellecha tzedek, velav shellecha tzedek. amar abbaye: hahu shello yedabber echad bappe veechad ballev.

Metivi, rabbi shimon omer: af al pi sheamru tallit kona dinar zahav, veen dinar zahav kone tallit, mikkol makom kach halacha. aval amru: mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umeanshe dor happelagga hu atid lippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo!

Tannae hi. ditnan: maase berabbi yochanan ben matya sheamar livno: tze usechor lanu poalim. halach ufasak lahem mezonot. ucheshebba etzel aviv, amar lo: beni, afillu atta ose lahem kisudat shelomo bishato lo yatzata yede chovatcha immahem, shehen bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov. ella ad shello yatchilu bimlacha, tze veemor lahem: al menat sheen lachem alay ella pat vekitnit bilvad.
Vei salka datach devarim yesh bahen mishshum mechussere amana, hechi amar leh zil hadar bach? shane hatam, defoalim gufayyhu la samcha datayyhu. may tama – midda yadi deal avu samech.
I hachi, afillu hitchilu bimlacha name? hitchilu bimlacha, vadday samchi datayyhu, amaru: memar amar kammeh daavu venicha leh.

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: haomer lachavero mattana ani noten lach – yachol lachazor bo. yachol, peshita! ella: muttar lachazor bo. amar rav pappa: umode rabbi yochanan bemattana muetet, desamcha datayyhu.

Hachi name mistabbera, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: yisrael sheamar leven levi: kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi. ben levi rashshay laasoto terumat maaser al makom acher. i amrat bishlama la matze lemihdar beh – mishshum hachi rashshay. ella i amrat matze lemihdar beh, ammay rashshay? ishtechach deka achel tevalim!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennetalo mimmennu vechazar vehifkido etzlo.

I hachi ema sefa: netano leven levi acher – en lo alav ella taromet. vei salka datach kegon shennetalo mimmennu vechazar vehifkido etzlo, ammay en lo alav ella taromet? kevan demashcheh mamona it leh gabbeh! ella lav, shema minna bidla netalo. shema minna.

Hahu gavra dihayv zuze ashshumeshme. lesof iyyaykkar shumeshme. hadaru behu vaamaru leh: let lan shumeshme, shekol zuzach. la shekel zuzeh, iggenuv. ato lekammeh derava. amar leh: kevan deamri lach shekol zuzach vela shekalyt, la mibbaya shomer sachar dela have, ella afillu shomer chinnam name la have. amaru leh rabbanan lerava: veha bae lekabbole aleh "mi sheppara"? amar lehu: hachi name.

Amar rav pappe, amar li ravina: ledidi amar li hahu merabbanan verav tavut shemeh, veamri la rav shemuel bar zutera shemeh, dei havo yahavi leh kol chalala dealma la (have ka) [have] meshanne bedibbureh. bedidi hava ovada: hahu yoma appanya demaale shabbeta hava, vahava yatevna, vaata hahu gavra vekae abbava. amar li: it lach shumeshme lezabbone?
b: Amari leh: la. amar li: lehvo hanach zuze befikkadon gabbach, deha chashacha li. amari leh: ha beta kammach. otvinhu beveta veiggenuv. ata lekammeh derava. amar leh: kol "ha beta kammach" la mibbaya shomer sachar dela have, ella afillu shomer chinnam name la have. amari leh: veha amaru [leh] rabbanan lerava: ibbei leh lekabbole aleh "mi sheppara". vaamar li: lo hayu devarim meolam.

Rabbi shimon omer: kol shehakkesef beyado – yado al haelyona vechulei. tanya, amar rabbi shimon: ematay – bizman shehakkesef vehapperot beyad mocher. aval kesef beyad mocher uferot beyad lokeach – eno yachol lachazor bo, mippene shekkaspo beyado. "beyado"?! beyad mocher hu. ella – mippene sheddeme chaspo beyado.

Peshita! amar rava: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta aliyyay shel lokeach musekeret beyad mocher. tama may takkinu rabbanan meshicha – gezera shemma yomar lo nisrefu chittecha baaliyyay. hacha birshuteh delokeach ninhu, i nafla deleka beones – ihu tarach umayyte la.

Hahu gavra dihayv zuze achamra. lesof shema deka vae leminseveh deve parzak rufila. amar leh: hav li zuzay, la baena chamra. ata lekammeh derav chisda, amar leh: kederech shettikkenu meshicha bammochrin kach tikkenu meshicha ballakochot.
Mishna haonaa, arbaa kesef meesrim vearbaa kesef lassela, shetut lemikkach. ad matay muttar lehachezir? ad kede sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo.

Hora rabbi tarfon belod: haonaa shemona kesef meesrim vearba kesef lassela, shelish lemikkach. vesamchu taggare lod. amar lahem: kol hayyom muttar lachzor. amru lo yanniach lanu rabbi tarfon bimkomenu, vechazru ledivre chachamim.

Gemara ittemar: rav amar: shetut mikkach shaninu. ushemuel amar: shetut maot name shaninu. shave shitta bechamsha, shave shitta beshiva – kulle alma la peligi devatar mikkach azlinan veonaa havya. ki peligi shave chamsha beshitta veshave shiva beshitta.
Lishmuel deamar: batar maot azlinan, idde veidde onaa have. lerav deamar: batar mikkach azlinan, shave chamsha beshitta bittul mikkach havya. shave shiva beshitta, mechila havya.
Ushemuel amar: ki amrinan mechila uvittul mikkach – hecha delekka shetut mishshene tzedadim. aval hecha deikka shetut mitztzad echad – onaa havya.

Tenan: haonaa arbaa kesef meesrim vearbaa kesef lassela, shetut lemikkach. may lav, dezabben shave esrim beesrin vearbea, ushema minna: shetut maot name shaninu! la, dezabben shave esrim vearbea beesrim.
Mi nitanna – mocher. ema sefa: ad matay muttar lehachezir – bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo. veamar rav nachman: lo shanu ella lokeach, aval mocher – leolam chozer.

Ella dezabben shave esrim vearbea beesrin utemanya. tenan, hora rabbi tarfon belod: haonaa shemona kesef meesrim vearbaa kesef lassela, shelish lemikkach. may lav, dezabben shave shittasre beesrim vearbea? ushema minna: shelish maot name shaninu.

La: dezabben shave esrim vearbea beshittesar. mi nitanna mocher, ema sefa: amar lahem – kol hayyom muttar lachzor. veamar rav nachman: lo shanu ella lokeach, aval mocher leolam chozer. ella dezabben shave esrim vearbea bitlatin uteren.

Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: mi shehuttal alav yado al haelyona. ketzad? machar lo shave chamishsha beshishsha, mi nitanna – lokeach, yad lokeach al haelyona, ratza omer: ten li meotay, o ten li ma sheonetani. machar lo

a: Shave shesh bechamesh, mi nitanna – mocher, yad mocher al haelyona. ratza omer lo: "ten li mikkachi", o "ten li ma sheonetani".

Ibbaya lehu: pachot mishshetut lerabbanan, lealtar havya mechila, o bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo? veim timtze lomar bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo, may ikka ben shetut lefachot mishshetut?
Ikka deillu shetut – yado al haelyona, ratza – chozer, ratza – kone umachazir onaa. veillu pachot mishshetut – kana, umachzir onaa.
May? ta shema: chazru ledivre chachamim.

Savruha pachot mishshelish lerabbi tarfon kefachot mishshetut lerabbanan dame. i amrat bishlama pachot mishshetut lerabbanan bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo, ulerabbi tarfon kol hayyom – mishshum hachi chazru. ella i amrat pachot mishshetut lerabbanan – lealtar havya mechila,
b: Ulerabbi tarfon name lealtar havya mechila, ammay chazru? bidrabbi tarfon nicha lehu tefe, demay derabbanan ka meshavve lehu onaa lerabbi tarfon havya mechila?
Mi savrat pachot mishshelish lerabbi tarfon kefachot mishshetut lerabbanan dame? la, mishshetut vead shelish lerabbi tarfon kishtut atzmah lerabbanan dame. i hachi, bemay samchu meikkara?
Tifshot devittul mikkach lerabbanan leolam chozer, dechevan daamar lehu rabbi tarfon havya onaa – samchu, ki amar lehu kol hayyom – chazru.
Dei salka datach devittul mikkach lerabbanan bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo, bemay samchu? samchu beshettut atzmah, dilrabbi tarfon mechila, ulerabbanan onaa.

Ibbaya lehu: bittul mikkach lerabbanan, leolam chozer, o dilma bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo? veim timtza lomar bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo, ma ikka ben shetut leyater al shetut? ikka: deillu shetut – mi shennitanna chozer, veillu yater al shetut – shenehem chozrim.

May? ta shema, chazru ledivre chachamim. i amrat bishlama bittul mikkach lerabbanan bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo, ulerabbi tarfon kol hayyom – mishshum hachi chazru. ella i amrat bittul mikkach lerabbanan leolam chozer, ammay chazru? bidrabbi tarfon nicha lehu tefe, deka meshavve lehu onaa kol hayyom vetu la!
Bittul mikkach la shechiach.
Amar rava, hilcheta: pachot mishshetut – nikne mikkach, yoter al shetut – bittul mikkach, shetut – kana umachzir onaa, veze vaze – bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo.

Tanya kevoteh derava: onaa pachot mishshetut – nikne mikkach. yater al shetut – batel mikkach. shetut – kana umachzir onaa, divre rabbi natan. rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: yad mocher al haelyona, rotze – omer lo: "ten li mikkachi", o "ten li ma sheonetani". veze vaze bichde sheyyare lattaggar o likrovo.
Ad matay muttar lehachazir kulei. amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella lokeach, aval mocher – leolam chozer. nema mesayyay leh: chazru ledivre chachamim. i amrat bishlama mocher leolam chozer,

a: Mishshum hachi chazru.
Ella i amrat mocher name kelokeach dame, may nafka lehu minna? ki hechi deavdi lay rabbanan takkanta lelokeach, hachi name avdi lay rabbanan takkanta lemocher!
Taggare lod la shechiach detau.

Ushepizchaneh derame bar chama zabben chamara utea. ashkecheh dahava atziv, amar leh: ammay atzivat? amar leh: zabbeni chamara uteay. amar leh: zil hadar bach. amar leh: ha shehay li yoter mikkede sheare lattaggar o likrovi! shaddereh lekammeh derav nachman, amar leh lo shanu ella lokeach, aval mocher – leolam chozer.
May tama? lokeach mikkacho beyado, kol hecha deazel machvi leh veamri leh i tea, i la tea. mocher dela naket mikkacheh bideh ad demitreme leh zevinta kizvinteh, veyada i tea vei la tea.

Hahu gavra dahava naket varsheche lezabbone, kare shitta veshavya chamsha, vei havo yahavi leh chamsha ufalga hava shakel. ata hahu gavra veamar: i yahevna leh chamsha ufalga havya mechila. etten leh shitta veetbeeh ledina. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: lo shanu ella belokeach min hattaggar, aval belokeach mibbaal habbayit – en lo alav onaa.

Hahu gavra dahava naket kippe lezabbone kare shittin veshave chamshin, vei havo yahavi leh chamshin vechamsha hava shakel. ata hahu gavra veamar: i yahevna leh chamshin vechamsha havya mechila, etten leh shittin veetbeeh ledina. ata lekammeh derav chisda. amar leh: lo shanu ella belokeach min hattaggar, aval belokeach min baal habbayit – en lo alav onaa.

Amar leh rav dimi: yishar. vechen amar rabbi elazar: yishar. veha anan tenan: keshem sheonaa lehedyot kach onaa lattaggar. man hedyot, lav baal habbayit? amar rav chisda: betzadreyayta. aval mane tashmishteh, deyakkiri aleh, la mezabben lehu i lav bidme yattire.

Mishna echad hallokeach veechad hammocher yesh lahen onaa. keshem sheonaa lahedyot kach onaa lattaggar. rabbi yehuda omer: en onaa lattaggar. mi shehuttal alav – yado al haelyona, ratza omer lo: ten li meotay, o ten li ma sheonetani.
Gemara menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha ... al tonu" – en li ella shennitanna lokeach, nitanna mocher minnayin? talmud lomar: "o kano ... al tonu".
Veitzterich lemichtav lokeach veitzterich lemichtav mocher, dei ketav rachamana mocher – mishshum dekim leh bizvinteh, aval lokeach – dela kim leh bizvinteh, ema la azhareh rachamana belo tonu".
Vei ketav rachamana lokeach – mishshum deka kane, deamri inashe: zevant kenet. aval mocher deovode ka moved, deamri inashe: zabben oved, ema la azhareh rachamana belo tonu", tzericha.
Rabbi yehuda omer: en onaa lattaggar. mishshum shehu taggar en lo onaa?!
Amar rav nachman amar rav: betaggar safsar shanu. may tama – midda yada zevinteh kamma shavya, veachole achel gabbeh. vehay dezabbena hachi – mishshum deitramya leh zevinta achariti.

Vehasheta miha ka hadar beh! rav ashe amar: may en lattaggar onaa – eno betorat onaa, sheafillu pachot mikkede onaa chozer. tanya kevoteh derav nachman: rabbi yehuda omer, taggar en lo onaa, mippene shehu baki.
Mi shehuttal alav yado al haelyona vechulei. manni matnitin? la rabbi natan vela rabbi yehuda hannasi.
I rabbi natan – matnitin katane "ratza", uvarayyta la katane "ratza". i rabbi yehuda hannasi – matnitin katane "lokeach", barayyta katane "mocher".
(Siman zav rash)

Amar rabbi elazar: onaa zo eni yodea mi shenaah. rabba amar: leolam rabbi natan hi, uteni name bevarayyta "ratza". rava amar: leolam rabbi yehuda hannasi hi, umay deshayyayr bematnitin ka mefaresh bevarayyta. amar rav ashe: dayka name, dekatane "echad hallokeach veechad hammocher", umefaresh leh lelokeach, shema minna shayyore shayyeyreh lemocher. shema minna.
Ittemar: haomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaa. rav amar: yesh lo alav onaa. ushemuel amar: en lo alav onaa. lema rav deamar kerabbi meir, ushemuel deamar kerabbi yehuda.

Detanya: haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheen lecha alay sheer kesut veona – hare zo mekuddeshet, utenao batel, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: bedavar shebbemamon – tenao kayyaym.
Amar lecha rav: ana daamari afillu lerabbi yehuda – ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam, ella deyada veka machala,
b: Aval hacha mi yada demachel?
Ushemuel amar: ana daamari afillu lerabbi meir, ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, ella devadday ka akar, aval hacha mi yemar deka akar midde.
Amar rav anan: ledidi mipparsha li minneh demar shemuel: haomer lachavero "al menat sheen lecha alay onaa" – en lo alav onaa. "al menat sheen bo onaa" – hare yesh bo onaa.
Metivi: hannose vehannoten baamana, vehaomer lachavero "al menat sheen lecha alay onaa" – en lo alav onaa. lerav deamar: ana daamari afillu lerabbi yehuda, ha manni?
Amar abbaye: mechavvavrta, rav amar kerabbi meir, ushemuel deamar kerabbi yehuda.
Rava amar: la kashya, kan – bistam, kan – bimfaresh.

Detanya: bamme devarim amurim – bistam. aval bimfaresh, mocher sheamar lallokeach: chefetz ze sheani mocher lach bematayim yodea ani bo sheeno shave ella mane. al menat sheen lecha alay onaa – en lo alav onaa. vechen lokeach sheamar lammocher: chefetz ze sheani lokeach mimmecha bemane yodea ani bo sheshshave matayim. al menat sheen lecha alay onaa – en lo alav onaa.
Tanu rabbanan: hannose vehannoten baamana, hare ze lo yechashshev et hara baamana veet hayyafe beshave. ella, o ze vaze baamana, o ze vaze beshave.
Venoten lo sechar kattaf, sechar gammal, sechar punedak. sechar atzmo – eno notel, shekkevar natan lo secharo mishshalem.
Secharo mishshalem mehecha ka yahev leh? amar rav pappa: betzadroye, deyahavi arba lima.
Mishna kamma tehe hassela chasera velo yehe bah onaa? rabbi meir omer: arba issarot, issar ledinar. verabbi yehuda omer: arba punedyonot, punedyon ledinar. verabbi shimon omer:

a: Shemona punedyonot, shene punedyonot ledinar.

Ad matay muttar lehachezir? bichrakkim – ad kede sheyyare lashshulechani, bichfarim – ad arve shabbatot. im haya makkirah – afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh mekabbelah hemennu, veen lo alav ella taromet.
Venotnah lemaaser sheni veeno choshesh, sheeno ella nefesh raa.
Gemara ureminhi: ad kamma tehe hassela chasera veyihye bah onaa?
Amar rav pappa, la kashya: tanna didan ka chashev mimmatta lemala, tanna bara ka chashev millemala lematta.
May shena besela difligi, umay shena betallit dela peligi?
Amar rava: man tena tallit – rabbi shimon hi. abbaye amar: tallit – ad shetut machel inish. deamri inashe: ashik legabbaych veshave lichresaych. sela, kevan dela saggi leh – la machel.

Gufa: ad kamma tehe hassela chasera vihe bah onaa? rabbi meir omer: arbaa issarot, issar ledinar. rabbi yehuda omer: arbaa punedyonot, punedyon ledinar. rabbi shimon omer: shemona punedyonot, shene punedyonim ledinar. yater al ken – mochrah beshovyah.

Ad kamma tippachet vihe rashshay lekayyeymah? besela – ad shekel. bedinar – ad rova. pachot mikken issar – asur lehotziah. hare ze lo yimkerenna lo lattaggar velo lecharam velo leharag, mippene shemmerammin bah et acherim. ella yikkovenna veyitlenna betzavvar beno o betzavvar bitto.
Amar mar: besela ad shekel, bedinar ad rova. may shena besela ad shekel, umay shena bedinar ad rova?
Amar abbaye: may "rova" dekatane – name rova shekel. amar rava: dayka name, deka tane "rova", vela katane "revia". shema minna.
Lema leh lemitleyeh ledinar beshekel? milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, deikka dinar deate mishshekel.
Mesayyay leh lerabbi amme. deamar rabbi amme: dinar habba mishshekel – muttar lekayyeymo. dinar habba missela – asur lekayyeymo.

Pachot mikken issar – asur lehotziah. may kaamar? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: pachata sela yoter mikkede onaa issar – asur. amar leh rava: i hachi – afillu mashshehu name! ella amar rava: pachata sela issar ledinar – asur, usetama kerabbi meir.
Tenan hatam: sela shennifsela vehitkinah sheyyehe shokel bah mishkalot – temea. ad kamma tippachet vihe rashshay lekayyeymah? (lassela) shene dinarim, pachot mikken – yakotz.
Yater al ken may? amar rav huna: pachot mikken – yakotz, yater al ken – yakotz. rabbi amme amar: pachot mikken – yakotz, yater al ken – yekayyem.
Metivi:
b: Yater al ken mochrah beshovyah. may lav: sheppachata yoter mikkede onaatah? la, yetera: deakkatti la pachata bichde onaatah, mochrah beshovyah.
Metivi: ad kamma tippachet, vihe rashshay lekayyeymah? besela – ad shekel. may lav difchayt pureta pureta! la, dinfil lenura veippechit bachada zimna.

Amar mar: yikkovenna veyitlenna betzavvar beno o betzavvar bitto. ureminhu: lo yaasenna mishkal ben mishkelotav, velo yizrekenna ben gerutotav, velo yikkovenna veyitlenna betzavvar beno uvetzavvar bitto. ella: o yishchok, o yittoch, o yakotz, o yolich leyam hammelach!
Amar rabbi elazar, veamri la rav huna amar rabbi elazar, la kashya: kan – baemtza, kan – min hatztzad.
Ad matay muttar lehachazir bichrakkim? ad sheyyare lashshulechani. bichfarim? ad arve shabbatot. may shena besela dimfalleg, umay shena betallit dela mefalleg?

Amar abbaye: ki tenan name matnitin – betallit bichrakkin tenan. rava amar: tallit, kol inish kim leh begavva. sela, kevan delav kol inish kim leh begavva ella shulechani, hilkach bichrakkim deikka shulechani – ad sheyyare lashshulechani. bichfarim delekka shulechani – ad arve shabbatot desalkin leshuka.
Veim haya makkirah afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh kulei. hecha? i bichrakkin, ha amrat ad sheyyare lashshulechani. i bichfarim, ha amrat ad arve shabbatot!

Amar rav chisda: middat chasidut shanu kan. i hachi, ema sefa: en lo alav ella taromet. leman? i lechasid – la kabbole likabbela minneh, vela taromet tehve leh. veella lehaych dekabbela minneh, ulevatar dimkabbela minneh – taromet tehve leh?
Hachi kaamar: ha acher, af al pi sheen mekabbelah hemennu – en lo alav ella taromet.
Venotnah lemaaser sheni, veeno choshesh, sheeno ella nefesh raa. amar rav pappa, shema minna: hay man demokem azzuze, mikkere nefesh raa. vehane mille hu desage lehu.
Mesayyay leh lechizkiyya, deamar chizkiyya: ba lefortah – portah beshovyah, ba lechallelah – mechallelah beyafa.
May kaamar? hachi kaamar: af al pi keshebba lefortah – portah beshovyah, keshehu mechallelah – mechallelah beyafa.

Lememra desavar chizkiyya dimzalzelinan bemaaser sheni? vehaamar chizkiyya: maaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta, omer: hu vechumesho mechullal al maot harishonot. lefi shei efshar lo leadam letzamtzem meotav!
May "beyafa", betorat yafa. ditre zile la mezalzelinan beh.
Gufa. amar chizkiyya: maaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta, omer: "hu vechumesho mechullal al maot harishonot", lefi shei efshar lo leadam letzamtzem meotav.
Metivi: hatteruma vehabbikkurim chayyayvin alehen mita vachomesh,

a: Vaasurim lezarim, vehen nichse chohen, veolim beechad umea, uteunin rechitzat yadayim veheerev shemesh. hare ellu bitruma uvikkurim, ma sheen ken bammaaser.
May "ma sheen ken bammaaser" – lav mikkelal demaaser batel berubba? veim ita dechizkiyya, hava leh davar sheyyesh lo mattirin. vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, afillu beelef lo batel!
Umimmay dema sheen ken bammaaser – devatel berubba? dilma la batel kelal! la matzet amrat hachi, dilgabbe teruma – chumere ditruma katane, kulle ditruma la katane. veha ka tane: vehen nichse chohen!

La salka datach, detanya behedya: maaser sheni batel berubba. uveeze maaser sheni amru – bemaaser sheen bo shave peruta, veshennichnas lirushalayim veyatza. veim ita lidchizkiyya, lebed leh lidchizkiyya, venichalleleh al maot harishonot! dela parek.
Venayte maaser deit leh (venitztarfinhu) [unetzaref]! deorayyta uderabbanan la mitztarfi.
Venayte demay! dilma ate leetoye vadday.

Venayte shete ferutot, unechallel alayyhu maaser bifruta umechetza, unechallel hay al hayech yattira. mi savrat: peruta umechetza tafsa shete ferutot? la. peruta tafsa peruta, vachatzi peruta la tafsa. hadar havya leh deorayyta uderabbanan. udeorayyta uderabbanan la mitztarfi.
Venayte issar! dilma ate leetoye perutot.
Veshennichnas lirushalayim veyatza. veammay: velihdar uneayyeyleh! beshennitma. venifrekeh! deamar rabbi elazar: minnayin lemaaser sheni shennitma, sheppodin oto
b: Afillu birushalayim – shenneemar: "ki lo tuchal seeto", veen "seet" ella achila, shenneemar: "vayyissa masot meet panav".
Ella belakuach bechesef maaser sheni. lakuach bechesef maaser name lifrekeh, ditnan: hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma – yippade! kerabbi yehuda deamar yikkaver.
I rabbi yehuda, may irya "yatza"? afillu lo yatza name, ella: leolam betahor, umay "yatza" – dinful mechitzot.

Vehaamar rava: mechitza leechol – deorayyta, mechitzot liklot – derabbanan. vechi gezaru derabbanan: ki itanhu limchitzot. ki letanhu limchitzot – la gezaru rabbanan! la pelug rabbanan ben itanhu limchitzot, ben letanhu limchitzot.
Rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet: chada katane: maaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta shennichnas lirushalayim veyatza. ammay? venihdar uneayyeyleh venechleh! dinful mechitzot.
Venifrekeh? haamar rava: mechitza leechol deorayyta, mechitza liklot derabbanan, vechi gezaru rabbanan – ki itanhu limchitzot. ki letanhu limchitzot – la gezaru rabbanan. la pelug rabbanan.
I hachi, may irya en bo shave peruta? afillu yesh bo name! la mibbaya kaamar. la mibbaya yesh bo, dekaltan leh mechitzot. aval en bo, ema: la kelatu leh mechitzot, ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: "im gaol yigal ish mimmaasro", mimmaasro – velo kol maasro. perat lemaaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta. ittemar. rav amme amar: en bo. rav assi amar: en bechumesho. rabbi yochanan amar: en bo. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: en bechumesho.
Metivi: maaser sheni sheen bo shave peruta – dayyo sheyyomar "hu vechumesho mechullal al maot rishonot".
Bishlama leman deamar "en bechumesho" – hayeynu dekatane "dayyo", deaf al gav divdideh it beh, kevan divchumesheh lekka – shappir. ella leman deamar "en bo", may "dayyo"? kashya.

Ibbaya lehu: chumesha millegav, o chumesha millevar? amar ravina, ta shema: habbealim omrim beesrim, vechol adam beesrim – habbealim kodmin mippene shemmosifin chomesh. amar echad: hare alay beesrim veechad –

a: Habbealim notnin esrim vashesh. esrim ushenayim – habbealim notnin esrim vasheva. beesrim veshalosh – habbealim notnin esrim ushemone. beesrim vearba – habbealim notnin esrim vatesha.
Esrim vechamesh – habbealim notnin sheloshim, lefi sheen mosifin chomesh al illuy shel ze. shema minna chumesha millevar. shema minna.
Ketannae: "veyasaf chamishito alav", sheyyehe hu vechumesho chamishsha, divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: chamishito chumesho shel keren.
Ibbaya lehu: chomesh meakkev, o eno meakkev? arbea bearbea parek, veakkenafsheh mosif chomesh, alma chomesh la meakkev. o dilma arbea bechamsha parek, vechomesh meakkev.
Amar ravina, ta shema: haddemay – en lo chomesh, veen lo biur.
Ha keren yesh lo. may tama? keren dimakkev bidorayyta – ita bidrabbanan, chomesh dela meakkev bidorayyta – leta bidrabbanan.

Lema ketannae: natan et hakkeren, velo natan et hachomesh, rabbi eliezer omer: yochal. rabbi yehoshua omer: lo yochal. amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi eliezer bashshabbat, vedivre rabbi yehoshua bachol.
Middeamar nirin divre rabbi eliezer bashshabbat, mikkelal difligi afillu bechol. middeamar nirin divre rabbi yehoshua bachol, mikkelal difligi afillu beshabbat.
May lav beha sevara kamippalgi: derabbi eliezer savar chomesh la meakkev, verabbi yehoshua savar chomesh meakkev?
Amar rav pappa: la, dechulle alma chomesh la meakkev. vehacha bechayyshinan lifshiuta kamippalgi. mar savar chayyshinan lifshiuta. umar savar la chayyshinan lifshiuta.
Amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim behekdesh – shechillel, hoil vegizbarin tovin oto bashshuk.

Uvehekdesh la peligi? vehatanya: natan et hakkeren, velo natan lo et hachomesh, rabbi eliezer omer: chillel, vachachamim omrim: lo chillel. amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi eliezer behekdesh, vedivre chachamim bemaaser.
Middeamar nirin divre rabbi eliezer behekdesh – mikkelal diflig afillu bemaaser. middekaamar nirin divre chachamim bemaaser – mikkelal deinhu peligi afillu behekdesh!
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim beshabbat behekdesh shechillel. chada – dichtiv: "vekarata lashshabbat oneg". veod, hoil vegizbarin tovin oto bashshuk.
Amar rame bar chama: hare amru hekdesh eno mitchallel al hakkarka, derachamana amar: "venatan hakkesef vekam lo". chumesho mahu sheyyitchallel al hakkarka?
Teruma enah mishtallemet ella min hachullin. derachamana amar: "venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh", davar harauy lihyot kodesh. chumeshah mahu sheyyishtallem shello min hachullin?
Maaser en mitchallel al haasimon. derachamana amar: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha", lerabbot kol davar sheyyesh alav tzura. chumesho mahu sheyyitchallel al haasimon?
Itgalgal milleta umeta lekammeh derava. amar lehu: amar kera "alav", lerabbot chumesho kemoto.

Amar ravina: af anan name tenena, haggonev teruma velo achalah – meshallem tashlume chefel deme teruma. achalah – meshallem shene keranim vachomesh. keren vachomesh min hachullin, vehakkeren deme teruma.
b: Shema minna chumesho kemoto. shema minna.
Amar rava, gabbe gazel ketiv: "vachamishitav yosef alav". utenan: natan lo et hakkeren, venishba lo al hachomesh – hare ze mosif chomesh al chomesh, ad sheyyitmaet hakkeren pachot mishshave peruta.

Gabbe teruma ketiv: "ish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga veyasaf chamishito alav". utenan: haochel teruma beshogeg – meshallem keren vachomesh. echad haochel veechad hashshote veechad hassach. echad teruma tehora, veechad teruma temea – meshallem chumeshah vechumesha dechumesha. veillu gabbe maaser, la michtav ketiv, vela mitna tene, vela ibbeoye ibbaya lan.

Gabbe hekdesh ketiv: "veim hammakdish yigal et beto veyasaf chamishit kesef erkecha". utenan: happode et hekdesho – mosif chomesh. chumesha tenan, chumesha dechumesha la tenan. may? gabbe teruma ketiv "veyasaf", gabbe kodesh name ha ketiv "veyasaf".

O dilma gabbe teruma ketiv "veyasaf": i shaklat leh levav divyasaf" veshadet leh al "chamishshito", have leh "chamishitav". gabbe hekdesh ketiv "veyasaf chamishit": af al gav dechi shaklat leh levav divyasaf" veshadet leh al "chamishit", sof sof have leh "chamishito".

Vetippok leh dehave leh hekdesh sheni. veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ahekdesh rishon mosif chomesh, al hekdesh sheni en mosif chomesh! amar leh rav pappi leravina: hachi amar rava: chomesh kitchillat hekdesh dame.
May have ala? amar rav tavyome mishshemeh deabbaye: amar kera "veyasaf chamishit kesef erkecha", makkish chumesho lechesef erko. ma kesef erko mosif chomesh – af kesef chumesho name mosif chomesh.

Gufa, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: al hekdesh rishon mosif chomesh, veal hekdesh sheni en mosif chomesh. amar rava: may tama derabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar kera: "veim hammakdish yigal et beto". hammakdish, velo hammatpis.

Tane tanna kammeh derabbi elazar: "veim babbehema hattemea ufada veerkecha", ma behema temea meyuchedet, shettechillatah hekdesh vechullah lashshamayim – umoalin bah, af kol shettechillatah hekdesh vechullah lashshamayim – moalin bah.

Amar leh rabbi elazar letanna: bishlama "kullah lashshamayim" – lemaote kadashim kallim, kevan deit lehu livalim begavvayyhu – let behu meila. ella "techillat hekdesh" lemaote may? techillat hekdesh hu deit beh meila, sof hekdesh let beh meila?! dilma leinyan chomesh kaamrat, ucherabbi yehoshua ben levi? amar leh: in, hachi kaamena.
Amar leh rav ashe leravina: behema temea bitchillat hekdesh ita?

a: Beemtza hekdesh, leta? amar leh: lefi sheenah besof hekdesh.
Amar leh rav acha: middifti leravina, beemtza hekdesh miha ita, velosef name chomesh! amar leh: hare hu kesof hekdesh, ma sof hekdesh eno mosif chomesh – af emtza hekdesh eno mosif chomesh.

Amar leh rav zutera bereh derav mari leravina: may chazet dimdammet leh lesof hekdesh? nedammeyeh litchillat hekdesh! amar leh: mistabbera lesof hekdesh hava leh ledammoye, shekken nitpas minnitpas. adderabba: litchillat hekdesh hava leh ledammoye, shekken davar sheyyesh acharav kedushsha middavar sheyyesh acharav kedushsha!
Kidamar rava "haola" – ola rishona. hachi name "hattemea" – temea rishona.
Tanya kevoteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: "para zo tachat para shel hekdesh", "tallit zo tachat tallit shel hekdesh" – hekdesho paduy, veyad hekdesh al haelyona.
"Para zo bechamesh selaim tachat para shel hekdesh", "tallit zo bechamesh selaim tachat tallit shel hekdesh" – hekdesho paduy. al hekdesh rishon mosif chomesh, al hekdesh sheni en mosif chomesh.
Mishna haonaa – arbaa kesef, vehattaana – shete kesef, vehahodaa – shave peruta.

Chamesh perutot hen: hahodaa shave peruta, vehaishsha mitkaddeshet beshave peruta, vehannehene beshave peruta min hahekdesh maal, vehammotze shave peruta chayyayv lehacheriz, vehaggozel et chavero shave peruta venishba lo, yolichennu acharav afillu lemaday.
Gemara tenena chada zimna: haonaa arbaa kesef meesrim vearbaa kesef lassela, shetut lemikkach! hattaana shete kesef vehahodaa shave peruta itztericha leh.
Ha name tenena: shevuat haddayyaynin, hattaana shete kesef vehahodaa shave peruta! sefa itztericha leh, dekatane: chamesh perutot hen.
Chamesh perutot hen kulei. velitne name haonaa peruta? amar rav kahana: zot omeret, en onaa lifrutot.
Velevi amar: yesh onaa lifrutot. vechen tane levi bematniteh: chamesh perutot hen: haonaa peruta, vehahodaa peruta, vekiddushe ishsha bifruta, vegazel bifruta, vishivat haddayyaynin bifruta.
Vetanna didan, may tama la katane yeshivat haddayyaynin? tena leh gazel.

Umi la tane gazel vekatane aveda? hanach itztericha leh: gazel – haggozel mechavero shave peruta venishba lo, yolichennu acharav vaafillu limdi. aveda – hammotze aveda shave peruta chayyayv lehacheriz, veaf al gav dezal.
Velevi, may tama la tane aveda bifruta? tena leh gazel.
Umi la katane gazel vekatane yeshivat haddayyaynin? yeshivat haddayyaynin itztericha leh, leappoke midderav kattina, deamar rav kattina: bet din nizkakin afillu lefachot mishshave peruta.
Velevi, may tama la katane hekdesh? bechullin kamayyre, bekadashim la kamayyre.
Ella tanna didan deka mayyre bekadashim, nitne maaser bifruta? keman deamar en bechumesho peruta. velitne chomesh maaser bifruta? bekarna ka mayyre, bechomesh la ka mayyre.
Gufa, amar rav kattina: bet din nizkakin afillu lefachot mishshave peruta. metiv rava: "veet asher chata min hakkodesh yeshallem",
b: Lerabbot pachot mishshave peruta lehishshavon. lekodesh – in, aval lehedyot – la.
Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav kattina, im huzekku bet din leshave peruta – gomrin, afillu lefachot mishshave peruta. techillat haddin baenan peruta, gemar haddin la baenan peruta.

Mishna chamishsha chumeshin hen, ellu hen: haochel teruma, uterumat maaser, uterumat maaser shel demay, vehachalla, vehabbikkurim – mosif chomesh. vehappode neta revai umaaser sheni shello – mosif chomesh. happode et hekdesho – mosif chomesh. hannehene shave peruta min hahekdesh – mosif chomesh. vehaggozel et chavero shave peruta venishba lo – mosif chomesh.
Gemara amar rava: kashya leh lerabbi elazar terumat maaser shel demay, vechi asu chachamim chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora?

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar asu chachamim chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora. detanya: hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, netano lah velo amar lah "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" – yotzi, vehavvalad mamzer, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: en havvalad mamzer. ketzad yaase? yittelennu mimmenna veyachazor veyittenennu lah bifne shenayim, veyomar lah: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam".

Ulerabbi meir, mishshum delo amar lah "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam", yotzi vehavvalad mamzer? in, rabbi meir letameh, deamar rav hamenuna mishshemeh deulla: omer haya rabbi meir: kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begittin – yotzi, vehavvalad mamzer.

Metiv rav sheshet: mechallelin oto kesef al kesef, nechoshet al nechoshet, kesef al nechoshet, unechoshet al happerot, veyachzor veyifde et happerot – divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yaalu perot veyochlu birushalayim.

Umi mechallelinan kesef al nechoshet? veha tenan: sela shel maaser sheni veshel chullin shennitarvu, mevi besela maot veomer: kol makom sheyyeshnah sela shel maaser sheni, mechullelet al maot hallalu, uvorer et hayyafe shebbahen umechallelo aleha.

a: Mippene sheamru: mechallelin (oto), kesef al nechoshet, middochak, lo sheyyekayyem ken, ella shechozer umechallelan al hakkesef. katane mihat: mechallelin middochak, middochak – in, shello middochak – la.

Amar rav yosef: af al pi shemmekel rabbi meir befidyono, machmir hu baachilato, detanya: lo hittiru limkor demay ella lesiton bilvad, uvaal habbayit. ben kach uven kach, tzarich leasser, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: echad hassiton veechad baal habbayit – mocher, vesholeach lachavero, venoten lo bemattana, veeno choshesh.
Metiv ravina: hallokeach min hannachtom, measser min hachamma al hatztzonenet, umin hatztzonenet al hachamma, vaafillu middefusim harebe, divre rabbi meir.

Bishlama min hatztzonenet al hachamma, kidrabbi ilay. deamar rabbi ilay: minnayin lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma? shenneemar: "velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu". im eno kodesh, nesiat chet lamma? mikkan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa, shetterumato teruma.
Ella afillu middefusim harebe, lechush dilma ate leafroshe min hachiyyuv al happetur, umin happetur al hachiyyuv!

Amar abbaye: rabbi elazar shappir ka kashya leh, ushemuel la shappir ka meshanne leh. dekashya leh lerabbi elazar: mita devide shamayim, umeshanne leh shemuel: mitat bet din. dilma shane mitat bet din dachamira!
Verav sheshet la shappir ka motev leh, dekaamri inhu mita. umotev rav sheshet lav, dichtiv "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha". ulemay demotev rav sheshet, rav yosef shappir ka meshanne leh.
Ella ravina, ad demotev minnachtom lesayyay leh mippalter! ditnan: hallokeach min happalter – measser min kol defus udefus, divre rabbi meir.
Ella may it lach lememar? palter mittere telata gavra zaven, nachtom name mechad gavra hu zaven.
Rava amar: shemuel shappir ka meshanne leh, shem mita baolam.

Mishna ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa: haavadim, vehashshetarot, vehakkarkaot, vehahekdeshot. en lahen tashlume chefel, velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. shomer chinnam eno nishba, venose sachar eno meshallem. rabbi shimon omer:
b: Kodashim shehu chayyayv beachrayutan – yesh lahen onaa. vesheeno chayyayv beachrayutan – en lahen onaa. rabbi yehuda omer: af hammocher sefer tora, behema umargalit – en lahem onaa. amru lo: lo amru ella et ellu.

Gemara menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha", davar hannikne miyyad leyad. yatzu karkaot, sheenan metaltelim. yatzu avadim, shehukkeshu lekarkaot. yatzu shetarot, dichtiv: "vechi timkeru mimkar", sheggufo machur vegufo kanuy. yatzu shetarot, sheen gufan machur veen gufan kanuy, veenan omdin ella liraya shebbahem.

Mikkan amru: hammocher shetarotav levassam, yesh lahem onaa. peshita! leappoke midderav kahana, deamar: en onaa lifrutot, ka mashma lan: yesh onaa lifrutot. hekdeshot? amar kera "achiv" – achiv, velo hekdesh.

Matkef la rabba bar memel: kol hecha dichtiv "yado", yado mammash hu? ella meatta, dichtiv "vayyikkach et kol artzo miyyado", hachi name dechol ara bideh hava naket la? ella mershuto, hacha name mershuto.
Vechol hecha dichtiv "yado", lav yado mammash hu? vehatanya: "im himmatze timmatze veyado", en li ella yado. gaggo, chatzero vekarpefo minnayin? talmud lomar: "im himmatze timmatze", mikkol makom.

Tama dichtav rachamana "im himmatze timmatze", ha lav hachi hava amena: kol hecha dichtav "yado", yado mammash hu. vetu, tanya: "venatan beyadah", en li ella yadah. gaggah chatzerah vekarpefah minnayin? talmud lomar: "venatan", mikkol makom. tama dichtav rachamana "venatan", ha lav hachi hava amena: kol hecha dichtav "yado", yado mammash.
Ella, kol "yado" – yado mammash hu. veshane hatam, delekka lememar hachi, ella birshuto.

Bae rabbi zera: sechirut yesh lo onaa, o en lo onaa? "mimkar" amar rachamana, aval lo sechirut, o dilma la shena? amar leh abbaye: mi ketiv "mimkar leolam"? "mimkar" setama ketiv, vehay name, beyomeh mechira hi.
Bae rava: chittin uzeraan bakkarka, mahu? yesh lahem onaa, o en lahem onaa? keman deshadyayn bechadda damyayn, veyesh lahem onaa, o dilma battelinhu al gav ara?

Hechi dame? ilema deamar ihu: "sheday ba shitta", vaato sahadi veamri dela sheda bah ella chamsha, vehaamar rava: kol davar shebbemidda veshebbemishkal veshebbeminyan, afillu pachot mikkede onaa – chozer!

Ella deamar ihu: "sheday bah kidibbei la", veiggallay milleta dela sheda bah kidibbei la, yesh lahem onaa o en lahem onaa? keman dishde bechadda damyayn veyesh lahem onaa, o dilma battelinhu aggav ara?
Nishbain alehen, o en nishbain alehen? keman deshadyayn bechadda damyayn venishbain alehen, o dilma battelinhu aggav ara veen nishbain alehen?
Omer mattiran o en omer mattiran? hechi dame: i deashrush – tenena, i dela ashrush – tenena! ditnan: im hishrishu kodem laomer – omer mattiran, veim lav – asurin ad sheyyavo omer habba!
La tzericha, dechatzdinhu vezarinhu kodem laomer, vaata leh omer vachalef illavayyhu, vela ashrush kodem laomer.

a: Mahu leminkat umechal minnayyhu: keman deshadyayn bechadda dame, usherinhu omer, o dilma battelinhu aggav ara? teku.

Amar rava: amar rav chassa, bae rabbi amme: onaa en lahem, bittul mikkach yesh lahem o en lahen? amar rav nachman: hadar amar rav chassa, pashet rabbi amme: onaa en lahem, bittul mikkach yesh lahem. rabbi yona amar ahekdeshot, rabbi yirmeya amar akkarkaot, vetarvayyhu mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amru: onaa en lahem, bittul mikkach yesh lahen.
Man deamar ahekdeshot, kol shekken akkarkaot. man deamar akkarkaot, aval ahekdeshot la. kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: hekdesh shave mane shechillelo al shave peruta – mechullal.

Tenan hatam: im haya kodesh baal mum, yatza lechullin, vetzarich laasot lo damim. amar rabbi yochanan: yatza lechullin – devar tora, vetzarich laasot lo damim – middivrehem. veresh lakish amar: af tzarich laasot lo damim min hattora.
Bemay askinan? ilema bichde onaa, beha lema resh lakish: tzarich laasot lo damim devar tora? vehatnan: ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa: hakkarkaot, vehaavadim, vehashshetarot, vehahekdeshot!

Ella bittul mikkach, beha lema rabbi yochanan tzarich laasot lo damim middivrehem? vehaamar rabbi yona ahekdeshot, verabbi yirmeya amar akkarkaot, vetarvayyhu mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amri: onaa en lahem, bittul mikkach yesh lahem! leolam bevittul mikkach, veefoch derabbi yochanan – leresh lakish, uderesh lakish – lerabbi yochanan.
Bemay kamippalgi? bedishmuel, deamar shemuel: hekdesh shave mane shechillelo al shave peruta – mechullal. mar it leh dishmuel, umar let leh dishmuel.
Ibbaet ema, dechulle alma it lehu dishmuel, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar shechillelo – in, lechattechilla – la. umar savar: afillu lechattechilla.
Ibbaet ema: leolam bichde onaa, vela tefoch, uvidrav chisda kamippalgi, deamar: may en lahem onaa? enan betorat onaa,
b: Daafillu pachot mikkede onaa chozer.
Metivi: ribbit veonaa lahedyot, veen ribbit veonaa lahekdesh! mi allima mimmatnitin deokemna betorat onaa? hachi name: ribbit vedin onaa lahedyot, veen ribbit vedin onaa lahekdesh.
I hachi, hayeynu dekatane sefa: ze chomer bahedyot mibbahekdesh? aribbit! litne name: ze chomer bahekdesh mibbahedyot, aonaa!
Hachi hasheta? bishlama, ze chomer bahedyot mibbahekdesh, vetu la. ella hekdesh, ze chomer vetu la?
Ribbit dehekdesh hechi dame? illema deozfeh gizbar mea bemea veesrim – vahalo maal haggizbar, vechevan shemmaal haggizbar, yatzu meotav lechullin, vehavu lehu dehedyot!

Amar rav hoshaya: hacha bemay askinan? kegon shekkibbel alav lesappek selatot mearba, veamdu mishshalosh. kidtanya: hamekabbel alav lesappek selatot mearba veamdu mishshalosh – mesappek mearba; mishshalosh veamdu mearba – mesappek mearba, sheyyad hekdesh al haelyona.
Rav pappa amar: hacha beavne vinyan hammesurot legizbar askinan, kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: bonin bachol, veachar kach makdishin.
En bahen tashlume chefel vechulei. menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "al kol devar pesha" – kelal, "al shor al chamor al se al salma" – perat, "al kol aveda asher yomar" – chazar vechalal.
Kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon.
Yatzu karkaot, sheenan mittaltelin. yatzu avadim, shehukkeshu lekarkaot. yatzu shetarot, sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon. hekdeshot – amar kera: "reehu" – reehu velo hekdesh.
Velo tashlume arbaa vachamishsha vechulei. may tama? tashlume arbaa vachamishsha amar rachamana, velo tashlume shelosha vearbaa.
Shomer chinnam eno nishba vechulei. menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ki yitten ish el reehu" – kelal, "kesef o kelim" – perat, "vegunnav mibbet haish" – chazar vechalal.
Kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat: ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon.
Yatzu karkaot, sheenan mittaltelin. yatzu avadim, shehukkeshu lekarkaot. yatzu shetarot, sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon. hekdeshot – amar kera: "reehu" – reehu, velo shel hekdesh.
Nose sachar eno meshallem vechulei. menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ki yitten ish el reehu" – kelal, "chamor o shor o se" – parat, "vechol behema lishmor" – chazar vechalal.
Kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat: ma happerat meforash – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon.
Yatzu karkaot, sheenan mittaltelin. yatzu avadim, shehukkeshu lekarkaot. yatzu shetarot, sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon. hekdeshot – amar kera: "reehu" – reehu, velo shel hekdesh.
Shomer chinnam eno nishba vechulei. ureminhu, bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen venignevu o sheavdu,
Im mishshennitrema hatteruma –

a: Nishbain laggizbarin, veim lav – nishbain livne hair, uvene hair shoklin acherim tachtehen. nimtzeu, o shehechzirum haggannavim – ellu veellu shekalim hem, veen olin lahem lashshana habbaa.

Amar shemuel: hacha benose sachar askinan, venishbain littol secharan. i hachi, nishbain laggizbarin? livne hair mibbee leh! amar rabba: nishbain livne hair bemaamad gizbarin, ki hechi dela nichshedinhu, vei name, ki hechi dela likro lehu "poshim".
Veha nignevu o sheavdu katane, veshomer sachar bigneva vaaveda chayyove michayyayv! vehacha name, nehi deshallome la meshallemi, agrayyhu miha lafsed.
Amar rabba: nignevu – belistim mezuyyayn, avdu – shettava sefinato bayyam.
Rabbi yochanan amar: ha manni? rabbi shimon hi, deamar: kadashim shechayyayv beachrayutan – yesh lahen onaa, venishbain alehem.
Hatinach ad shello nitrema hatteruma. mishshennitrema hatteruma, kadashim sheeno chayyayv beachrayutan ninhu, detanya: tormin al haavud, veal haggavuy, veal heatid liggavot.
Ella amar rabbi elazar: shevua zo takkanat chachamim hi, shello yehu bene adam mezalzelim bahekdeshot.

Nose sachar eno meshallem. rame leh rav yosef bar chama lerabba: tenan, nose sachar eno meshallem, ureminhu: hassocher et happoel lishmor et happara, lishmor et hattinok, lishmor et hazzeraim – en notnim lo sechar shabbat, lefichach en achrayut shabbat alav.
Haya sechir shabbat, sechir chodesh, sechir shana, sechir shavua – notnin lo sechar shabbat, lefichach achrayut shabbat alav. may lav leshallem?
La, lehafesid secharo. i hachi, resha dekatane: "en achrayut shabbat alav" – hachi name dilhafsid secharo? umi it leh sechar shabbat? veha katane: "en notnin lo sechar shabbat"! ishtik.
Amar leh: midde shemia lach beha? amar leh: hachi amar rav sheshet, beshekkanu miyyado. vechen amar rabbi yochanan, beshekkanu miyyado.
Rabbi shimon omer: kadashim shechayyayv beachrayutan – yesh lahen onaa. vesheeno chayyayv beachrayutan – en lahen onaa. tane tanna kammeh derabbi yitzchak bar abba:
Kadashim shechayyayv beachrayutan, chayyayv, sheani kore bahen: "baAdonai vechichesh". vesheeno chayyayv beachrayutan, patur, sheani kore bahen: "baamito vechichesh".
Amar leh: kelappe leyay?!
b: Ippecha mistabbera! amar leh: esmeya?
Amar leh: la. hachi kaamar: kadashim shechayyayv beachrayutan – chayyayv, deitrabbu mibba vechichesh". vesheeno chayyayv beachrayutan – patur, deimmeit mibbaamito vechichesh".

Rabbi yehuda omer: af hammocher sefer tora, margalit uvehema, en lahem onaa. tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: af hammocher sefer tora, en lah onaa – lefi sheen ketz ledameha. behema umargalit, en lahem onaa – mippene sheadam rotze lezavvevgan.
Amru lo: vahalo hakkol adam rotze lezavvevgan? verabbi yehuda, hane chashivi leh, vehane la chashivi leh. vead kamma? amar ammemar: ad kede demehem.
Tanya, rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: af hammocher sus vesayif vachatitom bammilchama – en lahem onaa, mippene sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh.

Mishna keshem sheonaa bemikkach umimkar, kach onaa bidvarim. lo yomar lo: bechamma chefetz ze? vehu eno rotze likkach. im haya baal teshuva, lo yomar lo: zechor maasecha harishonim. im hu ben gerim, lo yomar lo: zechor maase avotecha, shenneemar: "veger lo tone velo tilchatzennu".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "lo tonu ish et amito" – beonaat devarim hakkatuv medabber. atta omer beonaat devarim, o eno ella beonaat mamon? keshehu omer "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha", hare onaat mamon amur! ha ma ani mekayyem "lo tonu ish et amito"? beonaat devarim.

Ha ketzad? im haya baal teshuva, al yomar lo: "zechor maasecha harishonim". im haya ben gerim, al yomar lo: "zechor maase avotecha". im haya ger uva lilmod tora, al yomar lo: "pe sheachal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim, ba lilmod tora shenneemra mippi haggevura"?

Im hayu yissurin bain alav, im hayu cholaim bain alav, o shehaya mekabber et banav, al yomar lo kederech sheamru lo chaverav leiyyov: "halo yiratcha kislatecha tikvatcha vetom derachecha. zechor na mi hu naki avad".

Im hayu chammarim mevakkeshin tevua mimmennu, lo yomar lahem: "lechu etzel peloni shehu mocher tevua", veyodea bo shello machar meolam. rabbi yehuda omer: af lo yitle enav al hammikkach, beshaa sheen lo damim, shehare haddavar masur lallev, vechol davar hammasur lallev neemar bo "veyareta meelohecha".

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: gadol onaat devarim meonaat mamon, shezze neemar bo "veyareta meelohecha", veze lo neemar bo "veyareta meelohecha". verabbi elazar omer: ze begufo veze bemamono. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ze nittan lehishshavon, veze lo nittan lehishshavon.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bar yitzchak: kol hammalbin pene chavero barabbim, keillu shofech damim. amar leh: shappir ka amrat, dechazena leh deazel summaka veate chiuora. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: bemareva bemay zehiri? amar leh: beachvore appe, deamar rabbi chanina: hakkol yordin legehinnam, chutz mishshelosha.

Hakkol salka datach? ella ema: kol hayyordin legehinnam olim, chutz mishshelosha sheyyordin veen olin. veellu hen: habba al eshet ish, vehammalbin pene chavero barabbim, vehamechanne shem ra lachavero. mechanne hayeynu malbin? af al gav dedash beh bishmeh.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Noach lo leadam sheyyavo al sefek eshet ish, veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim. mena lan? middedaresh rava, dedaresh rava: may dichtiv "uvetzali samchu veneesafu... karu velo dammu"? amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, galuy veyadua lefanecha, sheim hayu mekarim besari, lo haya dami shotet laaretz.

Velo od ella, afillu beshaa sheoskin bingaim veohalot, omrim li: david, habba al eshet ish, mitato bamme? vaani omer lahem: mitato bechenek, veyesh lo chelek laolam habba. aval hammalbin et pene chavero barabbim, en lo chelek laolam habba.

Veamar mar zutera bar toviyya amar rav, veamri la: amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida, veamri lah: amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: noach lo leadam sheyyappil atzmo lechivshan haesh veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim. mena lan? mittamar, dichtiv: "hi mutzet vehi shalcha el chamiha".

Amar rav chinnana bereh derav idi: may dichtiv "velo tonu ish et amito"? am sheittecha betora uvammitzvot, al tonehu. amar rav: leolam yehe adam zahir beonaat ishto, shemmittoch sheddimatah metzuya, onaatah kerova.

Amar rabbi elazar: miyyom shennechrav bet hammikdash, ninalu shaare tefilla, shenneemar: "gam ki ezak vaashavvea satam tefillati". veaf al pi sheshshaare tefilla ninalu, shaare demaot lo ninalu, shenneemar: "shima tefillati Adonai veshavati haazina, el dimati al techerash".

Veamar rav: kol haholech baatzat ishto nofel begehinnam, shenneemar: "rak lo haya cheachav vegomer". amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: veha amri inashe, ittetach gutza – gechen vetilchosh lah! la kashya: ha bemille dealma, veha bemille deveta. lishshana acharina: ha bemille dishmayya, veha bemille dealma.

Amar rav chisda: kol hashshearim ninalim, chutz mishshaare onaa, shenneemar: "hinne Adonai nitztzav al chomat anach uveyado anach". amar rabbi elazar: hakkol nifra bide shaliach, chutz meonaa, shenneemar: "uveyado anach".

Amar rabbi avahu: shelosha en happargod ninal bifnehem: onaa, vegazel, vaavoda zara. onaa, dichtiv: "uveyado anach". gazel, dichtiv: "chamas vashod yishshama bah al panay tamid". avoda zara, dichtiv: "haam hammachisim oti al panay tamid vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda: leolam yehe adam zahir bitvua betoch beto, sheen meriva metzuya betoch beto shel adam ella al iske tevua, shenneemar: "hassam gevulech shalom chelev chittim yasbiech". amar rav pappa, hayeynu deamri inashe: kemishlam seare mikkadda, nakesh veate tigra beveta.

Veamar rav chinnana bar pappa: leolam yehe adam zahir bitvua betoch beto, shello nikreu yisrael dallim ella al iske tevua, shenneemar: "vehaya im zara yisrael vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyachanu alehem vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyiddal yisrael meod mippene midyan".

Veamar rabbi chelbo: leolam yehe adam zahir bichvod ishto, sheen beracha metzuya betoch beto shel adam ella bishvil ishto, shenneemar: "uleavram hetiv baavurah". vehayeynu daamar lehu rava livne machoza: okiru linshayychu, ki hechi detitatteru.
Tenan hatam: chatacho chuleyot, venatan chol ben chuleya lechuleya – rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammein.
b: Veze hu tannur shel achnay. may achnay? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shehikkifu[hu] devarim keachna zo, vetimmeuhu. tana: beoto hayyom heshiv rabbi eliezer kol teshuvot shebbaolam, velo kibbelu hemennu.

Amar lahem: im halacha kemoti – charuv ze yochiach. neekar charuv mimmekomo mea amma, veamri la: arba meot amma. amru lo: en meviin reaya min hecharuv. chazar veamar lahem: im halacha kemoti – ammat hammayim yochichu. chazru ammat hammayim laachorehem. amru lo: en meviin reaya meammat hammayim.

Chazar veamar lahem: im halacha kemoti – kotle bet hammidrash yochichu. hittu kotle bet hammidrash lippol. gaar bahem rabbi yehoshua, amar lahem: im talmide chachamim menatztzechim ze et ze bahalacha, attem ma tivchem? lo naflu mippene chevodo shel rabbi yehoshua, velo zakfu mippene chevodo shel rabbi eliezer, vaadayin mattin veomdin.
Chazar veamar lahem: im halacha kemoti – min hashshamayim yochichu. yatzata bat kol veamra: ma lachem etzel rabbi eliezer, shehalacha kemoto bechol makom.

Amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar: "lo vashshamayim hi!" may "lo bashshamayim hi"? amar rabbi yirmeya: shekkevar nittena tora mehar sinay, en anu mashgichin bevat kol, shekkevar katavta behar sinay battora "achare rabbim lehattot". ashkecheh rabbi natan leeliyyahu, amar leh: may aved kudesha berich hu behahi shata? amar leh: ka chayech veamar, "nitztzechuni banay! nitztzechuni banay!"

Amru: oto hayyom heviu kol teharot shettiher rabbi eliezer userafum baesh. venimnu alav uverchuhu, veamru: mi yelech veyodio? amar lahem rabbi akiva: ani elech, shemma yelech adam sheeno hagun veyodio, venimtza machriv et kol haolam kullo.

Ma asa rabbi akiva? lavash shechorim venitattef shechorim, veyashav lefanav berichuk arba ammot. amar lo rabbi eliezer: akiva, ma yom miyyamim? amar lo: rabbi, kimdumme li shechaverim bedelim mimmecha. af hu kara begadav vechalatz minalav, venishmat veyashav al gabbe karka.

Zalgu enav demaot, laka haolam: shelish bezetim, ushelish bechittim, ushelish bisorim. veyesh omrim: af batzek shebbide ishsha tafach. tana: af gadol haya beoto hayyom, shebbechol makom shennatan bo enav rabbi eliezer – nisraf.

Veaf rabban gamliel haya ba bisfina. amad alav nachshol letabbeo. amar: kimdumme li sheen ze ella bishvil rabbi eliezer ben hurekanos. amad al raglav veamar: ribbono shel olam, galuy veyadua lefanecha shello lichvodi asiti, velo lichvod bet abba asiti, ella lichvodcha, shello yirbu machlokot beyisrael. nach hayyam mizzapo.

Imma shalom, devethu derabbi eliezer, achateh derabban gamliel havay. mehahu maase veelach, la hava shavka leh lerabbi eliezer lemippal al appeh. hahu yoma resh yarcha hava, veichallaf la ben male lechaser. ikka deamri: ata anya vekae abbava, appika leh rifta.

Ashkachteh denafel al anpeh. amara leh: kum, (katlit laache) [ketalyte leach]. addehachi nefak shippura mibbet rabban gamliel dishchev. amar la: mena yedat? amara leh: kach mekubbelani mibbet avi abba: kol hashshearim ninalim chutz mishshaare onaa.
Tanu rabbanan: hameanne et hagger, over bishlosha lavin. vehallochatzo, over bishnayim.

May shena meanne, dichtivi shelosha lavin: "veger lo tone", "vechi yagur ittecha ger beartzechem lo tonu oto", "velo tonu ish et amito", veger bichlal amito hu. lochatzo name shelosha ketivi: "velo tilchatzennu", "veger lo tilchatz", "velo tihye lo kenoshe", veger bakkelal hu! ella, echad ze veechad ze bishlosha.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: mippene ma hizhira tora bishloshim veshishsha mekomot, veamri la: bearbaim veshishsha mekomot, beger? mippene shessoro ra.

May dichtiv "veger lo tone velo tilchatzennu ki gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim"? tenena, rabbi natan omer: mum shebbecha al tomar lachaverecha. vehayeynu deamri inashe: dizkif leh zekifa bidyutekeh, la nema leh lechavreh zekef binita.
Mishna en mearvin perot beferot, afillu chadashim bachadashim.

a: Veen tzarich lomar, chadashim bishanim.
Beemet amru: beyayin hittiru learev kashe berach, mippene shehu mashbicho. en mearvin shimre yayin beyayin, aval noten lo et shemarav.
Mi shennitarev mayim beyeno, lo yimkerennu bachanut, ella im ken hodio. velo lattaggar, af al pi shehodio, sheeno ella lerammot bo. makom shennahagu lehatil mayim bayyayin – yatilu.
Hattaggar notel mechamesh goranot venoten letoch megura achat, mechamesh gittot venoten letoch pitom echad, uvilvad shello yehe mitkavven learev.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: en tzarich lomar chadashot mearba vishanot mishshalosh deen mearvin, ella afillu chadashot mishshalosh vishanot mearba – en mearvin, mippene sheadam rotze leyashshenan.
Beemet amru: bayyayin hittiru learev kashe berach, mippene shehu mashbicho vechulei. amar rabbi elazar: ada amra, kol "beemet amru" – halacha hi.
Amar rav nachman: uven haggittot shanu.
Vehaiddana deka mearvi shello ben haggittot? amar rav pappa: deyadi veka machali. rav acha bereh derav ika amar: ha manni? rabbi acha hi, detanya: rabbi acha mattir bedavar hannitam.

Veen mearvin shimre yayin beyayin, aval noten lo et shemarav vechulei. veha amrat resha en mearvin kelal! vechi tema may "noten lo et shemarav"? deka moda leh, ha middekatane sefa: lo yimkerennu bachanut ella im ken modio, velo lattaggar af al pi shemmodio, mikkelal deresha af al gav dela moda leh!

Amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar, en mearvin shemarim shel emesh beshel yom, velo shel yom beshel emesh. aval noten lo et shemarav. tanya name hachi, rabbi yehuda omer: hashshofe yayin lachavero – hare ze lo yearev shel emesh beshel yom, velo shel yom beshel emesh. aval mearev shel emesh beshel emesh, veshel yom beshel yom.

Mi shennitarev mayim beyeno, hare ze lo yimkerennu bachanut, ella im ken modio vechulei. rava ayyto leh chamra mechanuta, mazgeh, tameh, la hava besim, shaddereh lechanuta. amar leh abbaye: veha anan tenan, velo lattaggar, af al pi shehodio! amar leh: mizga didi midda yedia. vechi tema detafe umechayyeyleh umezabben leh – im ken, en laddavar sof.
Makom shennahagu lehattil mayim bayyayin, yatilu vechulei. tana: lemechetza, lishlish, velirvia. amar rav: uven haggittot shanu.
Mishna rabbi yehuda omer: lo yechallek hachenvani kelayot veegozin lattinokot, mippene shehu margilan lavo etzlo. vachachamim mattirin. velo yifchot et hashshaar, vachachamim omrim: zachur lattov.
Lo yavor et haggerisin, divre abba shaul. vachachamim mattirin, umodim shello yavor meal pi megura, sheeno ella kegonev et haayin. en mefarkesin lo et haadam, velo et habbehema, velo et hakkelim.
Gemara may tamayyhu derabbanan? daamar leh: ana mefallegna amgoze, veat palleg shiske.
Velo yifchot et hashshaar, vachachamim omrim: zachur lattov vechulei. may tama derabbanan?
b: Mishshum deka marvavch letara:
Velo yavor et haggerisin, divre abba shaul. vachachamim mattirin vechulei. man chachamim? rabbi acha, detanya: rabbi acha mattir bedavar hannire.

En mefarkesin, lo et haadam vechulei velo et hakkelim. tanu rabbanan: en mesharbetin et habbehema, veen nofchin bakkeravayim, veen shorin et habbasar bammayim. may en mesharbetin? hacha targimu: mayya dechizra. zeeri amar rav kahana: mazkafta.

Shemuel shera lemirme tume lesarbala. rav yehuda shera lechaskose kirme. rabba shera lemiddak (tzarde) [tzadre]. rava shera letzallome gire. rav pappa bar shemuel shera letzallome dikkule. veha anan tenan: en mefarkesin lo et haadam, velo et habbehema, velo et hakkelim! la kashya: ha bechadte, ha beattike.
Pirkus deadam may hi? ki ha dehahu avda sava, daazal tzaveh leresheh uledikneh. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: zivnan! amar leh: yihyu aniyyim bene vetecha.

Ata lekammeh derav pappa bar shemuel, zavneh. yoma chad amar leh: "ashkeyayn mayya!" azal chavvevreh leresheh uledikneh. amar leh: "chazi daana kashshish meavuch". kare annafsheh: "tzaddik mitztzara nechelatz vayyavo acher tachtav".
Hadaran alach hazzahav
Mishna ezehu neshech veezehu tarbit?
Ezehu neshech? hammalve sela bachamishsha dinarin, satayim chittin beshalosh – asur, mippene shehu noshech.
Veezehu tarbit? hammarbe beferot. ketzad? lakach hemennu chittin bedinar zahav hakkor, vechen hashshaar. amdu chittin bishloshim dinarin.
Amar lo: ten li chittay, sheani rotze lemochran velikkach bahen yayin. amar lo: hare chittecha asuyot alay bishloshim, vahare lecha etzli bahen yayin, veyayin en lo.
Gemara middeshavek leribbit deorayyta, veka mefaresh derabbanan, mikkelal deorayyta, (d)neshecha vetarbit – chada milleta hi. veha kerae ketivi: neshech kesef, veribbit ochel!
Vetisbera deikka neshech belo tarbit, vetarbit belo neshech? neshech belo tarbit hechi dame?

I deozfeh mea bima veesrim, meikkara kayymi mea bedanka, ulevassof kayymi mea veesrim bedanka. neshech ikka – deka nachet leh, deka shakel minneh midde dela yahev. vetarbit lekka – delet leh ravvcha, dedanka ozfeh vedanka ka shakel minneh.
Sof sof, i batar meikkara azlat – hare neshech vahare tarbit. i batar besof azlat, la neshech ikka vela tarbit ikka.
Vetu, tarbit belo neshech hechi dame? i deozef mea bima, meikkara kayymi mea bedanka, ulevassof mea bechumesha.
I batar meikkara azlat – la neshech ikka vela tarbit ikka. i batar sof azlat – hare neshech vahare tarbit!
Ella amar rava: i atta motze lo neshech belo tarbit, velo tarbit belo neshech. velo chillekan hakkatuv ella laavor alav bishne lavin.

Tanu rabbanan: "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvemarbit lo titten ochlecha". en li ella neshech bechesef veribbit beochel. neshech beochel minnayin? talmud lomar: "neshech ochel". ribbit bechesef minnayin? talmud lomar: "neshech kesef".

a: Im eno inyan leneshech kesef, shehare kevar neemar "lo tashshich leachicha", tenehu inyan leribbit kesef.
En li ella belove, bemalve minnayin?
