Neemar neshech ballove veneemar neshech bammalve. ma neshech haamur ballove – lo chillakta bo ben bechesef ben beochel ben beneshech ben beribbit, af neshech haamur bammalve – lo tachlok bo ben bechesef ben beochel ben beneshech ben beribbit. minnayin lerabbot kol davar? talmud lomar: "neshech kol davar asher yishshach".

Ravina amar: la neshech beochel vela ribbit bechesef tzerichi kera, dei ketiv "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech veochlecha bemarbit" – kidkaamrat. hasheta dichtiv "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvemarbit lo titten ochlecha", keri beh hachi: "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvemarbit", "uveneshech uvemarbit lo titten ochlecha".
Veha tanna "neemar" "neemar" kaamar!
Hachi kaamar: illu lo neemar kera, hayiti omer gezera shava. achshav shenneemar kera, gezera shava la tzerich. ella gezera shava lema li? leneshech kol davar asher yishshach", dela ketiv bemalve.
Amar rava: lema li dichtav rachamana lav beribbit, lav begazel, lav beonaa?
Tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana lav beribbit – mishshum dechiddush hu, daafillu belove asra rachamana.
Vei ketav rachamana lav begazel – mishshum dival kurcheh, aval onaa – ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana lav beonaa, mishshum dela yada demachel.
Chada mechada la atya. tete chada mittarte. he tete? la lichtov rachamana lav beribbit, vetete mehanach. ma lehanach shekken shello middaat, tomar beribbit demiddateh.
La lichtov rachamana lav beonaa, vetete mehanach. ma lehanach, shekken en derech mikkach umimkar bechach.
Ella la lichtov rachamana lav begazel, vetete mehanach. demay parchat: ma leribbit shekken chiddush? onaa tochiach!
Ma leonaa shekken la yada umachel? ribbit tochiach!
Vechazar haddin: lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken gozlo. af ani avi gazel!
Amri: hachi name. ella, lav begazel lema li? lechovesh sechar sachir.
Kovesh sechar sachir, behedya ketiv beh "lo taashok sachir ani veevyon"! laavor alav bishne lavin.
Velokma beribbit veonaa, velaavor alav bishne lavin? davar hallamed meinyayno,
b: Uveinyayna desachir ketiv.
"Lo tignovu" dichtav rachamana lema li? lechidtanya: lo tignov – al menat lemekat, lo tignov – al menat leshallem tashlume chefel.
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: lav dichtav rachamana bemishkalot, lema li? amar leh: letomen mishkelotav bemelach. hayeynu gazel mealleya hu! laavor alav mishsheat asiyyay.

Tanu rabbanan: "lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammishkal uvammesura". "bammidda" – zo medidat karka, shello yimdod leechad bimot hachamma uleechad bimot haggeshamim. "bammishkal" – shello yatmin mishkelotav bemelach. "uvammesura" – shello yartiach.

Vahalo devarim kal vechomer: uma mesura shehi echad mishsheloshim ushelosha ballog hikpida alav tora – kal vechomer lehin, vachatzi hin, ushelishit hin, ureviit hahin, velog, vachatzi log, ureviit hallog.
Amar rava: lema li dichtav rachamana yetziat mitzrayim beribbit, yetziat mitzrayim gabbe tzitzit, yetziat mitzrayim bemishkalot?

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani hu shehivchanti bemitzrayim ben tippa shel bechor letippa sheenah shel bechor, ani hu sheatid lippara mimmi shettole meotav begoy umalva otam leyisrael beribbit, umimmi shettomen mishkelotav bemelach, umimmi shettole kala ilan bevigdo veomer: "techelet hu".

Ravina ikkela lesura difrat. amar leh rav chanina missura difrat leravina: yetziat mitzrayim dichtav rachamana gabbe sheratzim, lema li? amar leh: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, ani hu shehivchanti ben tippa shel bechor letippa sheenah shel bechor, ani atid lippara mimmi shemmearev kirve dagim temein bekirve dagim tehorin umochran leyisrael.
Amar leh: ana "hammaale" ka kashya li, may shena hacha "hammaale" dichtav rachamana?
Amar leh: lechidtana deve rabbi yishmael. detana deve rabbi yishmael, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ilmale (lo) heeleti et yisrael mimmitzrayim ella bishvil davar ze, sheen metammein bishratzim – dayyi.
Amar leh: umi nefish agrayyhu tefe meribbit umitztzitzit umimmishkalot? amar leh: af al gav dela nefish agrayyhu tefe, meisi lemechlinhu.
Veezehu tarbit, hammarbe beferot. ketzad? lakach hemennu chittim bedinar zahav vechulei. attu kol hane deamrinan ad hasheta, lav ribbit hu?
Amar rabbi avahu: ad kan shel tora, mikkan veelach shel divrehem. vechen amar rava: ad kan shel tora, mikkan veelach shel divrehem.
Ad kan – "yachin rasha veyilbash tzaddik". ad kan, vetu la? ella, afillu ad kan – "yachin rasha veyilbash tzaddik"!
Ad kan – ribbit ketzutza. mikkan veelach – avak ribbit.
Amar rabbi elazar: ribbit ketzutza yotza bedayyaynin, avak ribbit enah yotza bedayyaynin. rabbi yochanan amar: afillu ribbit ketzutza name enah yotza bedayyaynin.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: may tama derabbi yochanan? deamar kera: "banneshech natan vetarbit lakach vachay lo yichye et kol hattoevot haelle asa" – lemita nittan velo lehishshavon. rav adda bar ahava amar, amar kera: "el tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit veyareta meelohecha" – lemora nittan velo lehishshavon.
Rava amar: miggufeh dikra shemia leh, "mot yumat damav bo yihye". hukeshu malve ribbit leshofche damim: ma shofche damim lo nittenu lehishshavon – af malve ribbit lo natnu lehishshavon.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may tama derabbi elazar? deamar kera:

a: "Veche achicha immach". ahdar leh ki hechi deneche.

Verabbi yochanan, hay "veche achicha immach" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: shenayim shehayu mehallechin badderech uveyad echad mehen kiton shel mayim, im shotin shenehem – metim. veim shote echad mehen – maggia layyishshuv. darash ben petora: mutav sheyyishtu shenehem veyamutu, veal yire echad mehem bemitato shel chavero. ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed: "veche achicha immach", chayyecha kodmim lechayye chaverecha.
Metivi: hinniach lahem avihem maot shel ribbit, af al pi sheyyodim shehen shel ribbit – enan chayyayvin lehacheziran. ha avihen chayyayv lehachezir!

Bedin hu daavuhon name la michayyayv lehachezir, veayyeyde deka vae lemitne sefa: hinniach lahen avihem para vetallit vechol davar hamesuyyam chayyayvin lehachezir mippene kevod avihem, tane name resha bedidhu.
Vehane, mippene kevod avihem mi michayyeyvi? keri kan: "venasi veammecha lo taor", beose maase ammecha.
Kidamar rabbi pinchas mishshemeh derava: besheasa teshuva, hacha name besheasa teshuva. i asa teshuva, may bae gabbeh? shello hispik lehachezir ad shemmet.

Metivi: haggazlanin umalve ribbit, af al pi sheggavu – machzirin. gazlanim may "af al pi sheggavu" ikka? i gezul – gezul, i la gezul – gazlanin karet lehu?! ella ema: gazlanin, may nihu? malve ribbit. af al pi sheggavu – machzirin.
Tannae hi, detanya: rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov potrin et hammalve veet hearev, mippene sheyyesh bahen kum ase. may kum ase? lav mishshum deamrinan lehu kumu ahaduru?
Mikkelal detanna kamma savar lav bene ahdore ninhu! la, may "kum ase" – likroa shetara.
May kasavar? i kasavar shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame, veha avadu issurayyhu. vei lav kegavuy dame, ha la avud velo kelum!
Leolam kasavar shetar haomed ligbot lav kegavuy dame, veha ka mashma lan desuma milleta hi.
Hachi name mistabbera, ditnan: veellu ovrim belo taase: hammalve vehallove, hearev vehaedim. bishlama kullehu avud maase, ella edim may avud? ella lav, shema minna desuma milleta hi. shema minna.
Amar rav safra: kol sheillu bedinehem motziim millove lemalve, bedinenu machzirin mimmalve lelove. kol sheillu bedinehem en motziin millove lemalve, bedinenu en machzirin mimmalve lelove.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: uchelala hu? vahare sea bisa – divdinehem motziin millove lemalve, uvedinenu en machzirin mimmalve lelove! amar leh: inhu betorat pikkadon ata lideh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vahare mashkanta bela nachyeyta – divdinehem motziin millove lemalve
b: Uvedinenu en machzirin mimmalve lelove. amar leh: inhu, betorat zevine ata lidayyhu.

Ella kol sheillu bedinehen, dekaamar rav safra: may ata leashmoinan! hachi ata leashmoinan: kol sheillu bedinehen motziin millove lemalve, bedinenu machzirin mimmalve lelove, umay nihu – beribbit ketzutza, vechidrabbi elazar.
Kol sheillu bedinehem en motziin, bedinenu en machzirin – ribbit mukedemet, ribbit meucheret.
Ketzad: lakach hemennu chittim bedinar zahav hakkor, vechen hashshaar vechulei. vechi en lo yayin, may have?
Vehatanya: en poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar, yatza hashshaar – poskin, af al pi sheen laze, yesh laze!
Amar rabba: matnitin beva lachuv bidmehen askinan.

Vechidtanya: hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane, vehalach veamad al gorno, veomer: ten li meotay, sheani rotze likkach bahem chittim. amar lo: chittim yesh li sheani noten lecha, tze vaase alay keshaar shel achshav, vaani aale lecha kol shenem asar chodesh – asur, delav keissaro habba leyado dame.
Amar leh abbaye: i dela keissaro habba leyado, may irya "en lo"? afillu yesh lo name! ella amar abbaye: matnitin, kidtane rav safra beribbit deve rabbi chiyyay.

Detane rav safra beribbit deve rabbi chiyyay: yesh devarim shehem muttarin vaasurin mippene haaramat ribbit. ketzad? amar lo: haleveni mane! amar lo: mane en li, chittin bemane yesh li sheani noten lach. natan lo chittin bemane, vechazar ulekachan hemennu beesrim vearba sela – muttar, veasur laasot ken mippene haaramat ribbit.

Hacha name. kegon deamar: haleveni sheloshim dinarim, amar leh: sheloshim dinarim en li, chittin bishloshim dinarim yesh li sheani noten lach. natan lo chittin bishloshim dinarim, vechazar ulekacham hemennu bedinar zahav. i it leh chamra lelove, deyahev leh bishloshim dinar – pera hu deka shakel minneh, velet lan ba. vei la, kevan delet leh chamra – vadday mishkal zuze minneh, michaze keribbit.

Amar leh rava: i hachi, "ten li chittay", deme chittay mibbee leh! teni "deme chittay". "sheani mochran", "shemmechartim lach" mibbaya leh! teni "shemmechartim lach". "hare chittecha asuyot alay bishloshim dinarin", meikkara name hachi okminhu illaveh! hachi kaamar leh: bidme chittecha sheasita alay bishloshim dinar.
"Hare lach etzli bahen yayin veyayin en lo", veha "bedinar zahav hakkor vechen hashshaar" katane! ella amar rava: ki shachevna rabbi oshaya nefak levoti,

a: Dimtaratzna matnitin kevoteh.

Detane rabbi oshaya: hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane, vehalach veamad al gorno veamar: ten li meotay, sheani rotze likkach bahen chittin. veamar lo: chittin yesh li sheani noten lecha, tze vaasaen alay keshaar shel achshav. higgia zeman chittin limkor, amar lo: ten li chittin, sheani rotze lemochran velikkach bahen yayin. amar lo: yesh li yayin sheani noten lecha, tze vaasaen alay keshaar shel achshav.

Higgia zeman yayin limkor, veamar lo: ten li yeni sheani rotze lemochro velikkach bo shemen. amar lo: shemen yesh li sheani noten lecha, tze vaasehu alay keshaar shel achshav. kullam, im yesh lo – muttar. en lo – asur. umay "lakach" – lakach behalevaato.
Amar rava: shema minna midderabbi oshaya telat. shema minna demaamidin milve al gabbe perot, vela amrinan dela keissaro habba leyado hu. ushema minna: hu deyesh lo. ushema minna: ita lidrabbi yannay.
Deamar rabbi yannay: ma li hen ma li demehen.
Deittemar, rav amar: osin amana beferot. veen osin amana bedamim. verabbi yannay amar: ma li hen, uma li demehen.
Metivi: kullam, im yesh lo muttar. amar rav huna amar rav: beshemmashach. i beshemmashach tzericha lememar? ella kegon sheyyiched lo keren zavit.
Ushemuel amar: ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: tzad echad beribbit muttar.

Detanya: hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane, veasa lo sadehu mecher. bizman shehammocher ochel perot – muttar. lokeach ochel perot – asur. rabbi yehuda omer: af bizman shehallokeach ochel perot – muttar.
Amar lahem rabbi yehuda: maase bevaytos ben zonin sheasa sadehu mecher al pi rabbi elazar ben azarya velokeach ochel perot haya! amru lo: mishsham reaya?! mocher ochel perot haya, velo lokeach.
May benayyhu? amar abbaye: tzad echad beribbit ikka benayyhu. rava amar: ribbit al menat lehachazir ikka benayyhu.
Amar rava, hasheta deamar rabbi yannay:
b: Ma li hen uma li demehen – amrinan, ma li demehen uma li hen – name amrinan. ufoskin al shaar shebbashshuk, veaf al pi sheen lo.
Etiveh rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: kullam, im yesh lo – muttar, im en lo – asur! amar lehu: hatam halevaa, hacha zevine.

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: may tama amaru rabbanan poskin al shaar shebbashshuk veaf al pi sheen lo? deamar leh: shekila tevutaych veshadyay achizre. may ahnet li? i havo li zuze bide – hava mezabbenyna behine uveshile bezula.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ella meatta muttar lilvot sea bisa, mishshum dematze amar leh: shekila tevutaych veshadyay achizre, deamar leh: chitte dekadchi baachalbay? amar leh: hatam halevaa, hacha – zevine.
Amar leh adda bar abba lerava: veha bae lemittav zuze lesafsera! amar leh: deka yahev leh name. rav ashe amar: zuze deinashe inhu avdi leh safseruteh.
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hay man deyahev zuze attara charifa, tzarich leitchazoye leve dare.
Lemay? i lemikne – ha la kane, i lekabbole aleh "mi sheppara", ki la mitchaze name mekabbel aleh "mi sheppara"!
Leolam lekabbole aleh "mi sheppara", uman deyahev zuze attara [charifa], leve tere telata yahev, i mitchaze leh – samcha dateh, vei la – amar leh: amena deashkacht pere deshappire middidi ushekalt.
Amar rav ashe: hasheta deamrat mishshum mismach data, afillu ashkecheh beshuka vaamar leh – samcha dateh.

Amar rav nachman: kelala deribbita, kol agar netar leh – asur. veamar rav nachman: hay man deyahev zuze lekiraa veka azli arba arba, vaamar leh: yahevna lach chamesh chamesh, itanhu gabbeh – shere, letanhu gabbeh – asur.

Peshita! la tzericha deit leh ashray bemata. mahu detema: kevan deit leh ashray bemata – kead sheyyavo beni" o "ad sheemtza mafteach" dame, ka mashma lan kevan dimchasseri guveyayna – keman deletanhu dame.
Veamar rav nachman: hay man deozef peshite mechavreh veashkach beh tufeyayna, i bichde shehaddaat toa – michayyayv leahadoreh leh, vei lav – mattana bealma hu deyahev leh.
Hechi dame "bichde shehaddaat toa"? amar rav acha bereh derav yosef:

a: Beissureyayta vechumeshyayta.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: vei inish takkifa hu dela yahev mattana, may? amar leh: dilma migzal gazleh veavla leh becheshbon. detanya: haggozel et chavero vehivlia lo becheshbon – yatza.
Vei inish deate mealma, dela shakel vetare bahadeh, may? amar leh: dilma inish acharina gazleh, vaamar leh: ki yazef peloni peshite minnach – avla leh becheshbon.
Amar rav kahana: hava yatevna beshilhe pirke derav, ushemait dekaamar "kare kare" vela yadana may kaamar. batar dekam rav, amri lehu: may "kare kare" dekaamar rav?
Amaru li, hachi kaamar rav: hay man deyahev zuze leginnaa akkare, veka azli asara kare bene zarta, vaamar leh: yahevyna lach bene garmida, itanhu – shere, letanhu – asur.
Peshita! mahu detema: kevan demimmela ka ravu – shappir dame, ka mashma lan.

Keman – ki hay tanna. detanya: haholech lachlov et izzav, veligzoz et rechelav, velirdot et kavvavrto, metzao chavero veamar lo: ma sheizzay cholvot machur lach, ma sherchelay gozzot machur lach, ma shekkavvavrti roda machur lach – muttar.

Aval im amar lo: ma sheizzay cholvot kach vechach machur lach, ma sherchelay gozzot kach vechach machur lach, ma shekkavvavrti roda kach vechach machur lach – asur. veaf al gav demimmela ka ravu, kevan deletanhu behahi shata – asur.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: kevan demimmela ka ravu – shappir dame. vehatanya: kach vechach – asur!
Hatam lav minneh ka ravu, deshakli leh lehay veate acharina beducheteh. hacha minneh ka ravu, dechi shakli leh lehay – la ate acharina beducheteh.
Amar abbaye: share leh leinish lememar leh lechavreh, helach arbea zuze achavita dechamra, i takfa – birshutach, i yakra i zila – birshutay. amar leh rav sherevya leabbaye:
b: Hay karov lesachar verachok lehefsed hu. amar leh kevan dimkabbel aleh zola, karov laze velaze hu.
Mishna: hammalve et chavero lo yadur bachatzero chinnam, velo yiskor mimmennu befachot – mippene shehu ribbit.

Gemara amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: af al pi sheamru haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato – eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. hilvahu vedar bachatzero – tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. may ka mashma lan? tenena: hammalve et chavero lo yadur bachatzero chinnam, velo yiskor mimmennu befachot, mippene shehu ribbit!
I mimmatnitin, hava amena: hane mille bechatzer dekayyma leagra, vegavra daavid lemegar. aval chatzer dela kayyma leagra, vegavra dela avid lemegar – ema la, ka mashma lan.

Ikka deamri, amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: af al pi sheamru haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato – eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. "haleveni vedur bachatzeri" – tzarich lehaalot lo sachar.
Man deamar hilvahu – kol shekken haleveni. uman deamar haleveni – aval hilvahu la. may tama – kevan demeikkara lav addata dehachi ozfeh – let lan ba.

Rav yosef bar chama takef avde deinashe demassek behu zuze, veaved behu avidta. amar leh rava bereh: may tama aved mar hachi? amar leh: ana kerav nachman sevira li, deamar rav nachman: avda, nehom kereseh la shave.

Amar leh: emor deamar rav nachman kegon daru avdeh dimrakked be chuve, avde acharine mi amar? amar leh: ana, ki ha derav daniel bar rav kattina amar rav sevira li. deamar: hattokef avdo shel chavero veasa bo melacha – patur.
